bdag nyid de ltar mthong nas de nas yang 'jigs pa skyes te/ des7lha gzhan dag la 'di skad smras so/ /grogs po dag shing ljon pa rnams la mi sdug pa 'di dag mthong ngam/ ji ltar bdag gis mthong ba ltar ci khyed kyis mthong ngam/de dag gis 'di skad smras so/ /bdag cag gis ma mthong ste/ gang gis nges par myong bar 'gyur ba'i las ma byas pa de dag gis ni de nyid mi mthong la/gang gis byas pa des ni mthong ngo / /bdag nyid yi dgas kyi 'jig rten du 'gro ba des lha de dag la smras pa/ grogs po dag khyed kyis mthong ngam/ des smras pa / mthong ngo / /de gnyis yi dgas kyi 'gro ba der sdug bsngal chen po mthong nas ji ltar tshe rabs stong du gyur pa de ltar lha'i bde ba de dag brjedashede/ de shin tu yi chad nas de nas yang yul de nas 'pho bar byed do/ /de nas7yang lha'i bde ba'i dbang du gyur nas/ de gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg bya yid du 'ong ba la ni chags④/ tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal dang / pad ma'i rdzing gi 'gram rnam pa sna tshogs dang / bya sgra sna tshogs 'byin pa dang / tshal gyi bar bar dag na dga' bar byed la/ lha mo cha byad sna tshogs thogs pa dang yang lhan cig dga' bar byed do/ /de nas yang sredashepas bdas pa na/ yang skabs shig tu/ me long lta bu'i tshal du song ba dang /de nas yang nges par myong ba'i las kyi skul ⑧bas bskul ba bdag nyid dud 'gror song nas gcig la gcig za ba de mthong ste/ gzhan gyis kyang de la za la des kyang gzhan la za ba dud 'gro phan tshun za ba'i sdug bsngal chen po ji ltar sngon des byas pa bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo / /des bdag nyid de lta bur gyur pa mthong nas de nas yang mi dga' ba chen po skyes te/ bdag nyid kyi gzugs che 69—148

la mi sdug pa sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa mang po du ma ci ste mthong zhig 0)gu snyam nas des yang gzhan dag la yang snga ma bzhin du smras so/ /de nas yang yul la sems rnam par chags pa/ yul gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg bya sdug pa rnams kyi dbang du gyur pa dag de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi phyang mo la nyug go/ /de nas yang mes long lta bu'i tshal de nyid du mir skyes pa mthong ste/ ji ltar mdza' bshes dang / gnyen 'dun dang / rtsa lag phan tshun kho na byung ste/ bye ba dag sdud cing bsdum dbyas pa'i tshul khrims kyi las dang ldan pa thams cad des mthong ba dang / bdag ni rgyu de dang / rkyen de dang ske/ gzhi des lus dang bral nas bde 'gro lha'i nang 'dir skyes pa lta snyam nas / de las bdag gir bya ba dang / las kyi bgo pa skal la spyod par bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo / /des de dag mthong nas de nas yang mi dga' ba skyes so/ /de nas yang sems mi brtan pa lha'i bde ba'i dbang du gyur pa de/ gzugs dang ske/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya bde ba dag la spyod par byed do / /de ltar sems rab tu myos pa de/ de nas yang bde ba'i myos pas sems g.yengs pa rab tu myos shing bag med pa la gnas pa dag dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu de nyid la spyod par byed do/ /des bdag nyid lha'i 'jig rten de nas shi ste/gzhan du skye la/ de nas yang sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang /dud 'gro'i nang du skye bar mthong ngo / /de nas bdag nyid de lta bur 'gyur ba mthong ba dang / shin tu mi dga' ba skyes nas/ gnas 'di ni mi rtag pa/mi brtan pa/ 'gyur ba'i chos can yin te/ de lta bas na 'di nas bdag nyid 'chi bar 'gyur zhing / lha mo 'di dag la yang bdag dbang bar mi 'gyur 69wa 149

te/ kye ma chos thams cad ni 'bral ba dang / 'dus byas kyi chos rnams ni mi brtan la gnod pa dang bcas pas rtab rtabanyepor 'dug pa yin te/ bdag cag ni phan tshun 'bral ba yin no snyam mo/ /de de ltar sems pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dag gis7lha'i 'jig rten la smras pa/ da khyed cag thugs dgyes par mdzod cig /'dzam bu'i gling na da dung du chos dang ldan zhing chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i mi mar 'dzin pa/ phar 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong du 'dzin pa/bram zer 'dzin pa dag yod pas lha'i phyogs ni 'phel lo/ /bdud kyi phyogs ni 'grib po/ /'jig rten na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa / skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba byung ste/ de chos 'chad pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge bdu/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba bde ba thams cadakyidang ldan pa/ zhi ba'i chos 'di lta ste/ 'di ni gzugs / gzugs 'di ni kun 'byung ba/ gzugs 'di ni 'gog pa/gzugs 'di ni 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam yin no zhes 'chad do/ /de thos nas me long lta bu'i tshal de na 'khod pa gang yin pa bdag nyid kyi las kyi 'bras bu'i rnam pa mthong ba des/ 'jig rten skyong ba de dag la smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ba dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ de su zhig yin / de nas 'jig rten skyong ba de dag gis slar smras pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling 69—150

du byung ba 'di ni sems can thams cad la chos ston pa yin no/ /de nas lha de 'jig rten skyong ba dag las de skad thos nas 'dzam bu'i gling ga la ba der 'gro bar byed de/ lha de lha'i 'jig rten nas 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs skrag /mi'i 'jig rten nas 'chi bas 'jigs skrag /dud 'gro'i 'jig rten na/gcig la gcig za bas 'jigs skrag /yi dgas kyi 'jig rten na bkres pa dang ske/ skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs skrag /sems can dmyal ba dag na gnod pas 'jigs skrag ste/ de ltar 'gro ba lnga rnams na 'jigs pa lnga yod par mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das mdzes pa/ gsal ba/ dbang po zhi ba/ thugs zhi ba/ dul ba dang zhi gnas mchog brnyes pa/ dul ba dang zhi gnas dam pa brnyes pa/ skyes bu glang po/ skyes bu cang mkhyen pa/ gser gyi phung po ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/nyi ma gnyis pa ltar 'od gsal 51)ba/ ri rab ltar brtan pa/ mtsho na)ltar zab pa / gser gyi ri bo lta bu shing ljon pa'i drung na bzhugs pa des rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /lha'i yang lha rnams dkyide lta bu de mthong nas dad pa skyes pa'i lha 4bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs te phyag 'tshal zhinanas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ lhas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang rtags6 pa brtan pa ther zug 'gyur ba ma mchis pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i gnas lta 7mchis lags sam/de nas bcom ldan 'das 8)kyis lha dag la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i gtam de dag bstan to/ /de nas lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las gtam de dag thos nas ji lta ba bzhin sems la bzung 9ste/ de nas yang lha'i 'jig rten ga 69—151

la ba der dong ngo / /der dong nas kyang de nas yang lha'i bde banyernam pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa zado par ma gyur pa de srid du dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi rnams kyi nang du skyes na/ las de dang rgyu 'thun par de kho na nyid mthong bar mi 'gyur la/de rtag tu mdza' bshes dang / gnyen 'dab dang / rtsa lag shin tu mi phyed pa dang ldan zhing nor bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha phreng thogs kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha'i 'jig rten na 'dod pa la chags pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can gang dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ desakhuthos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ gang gis chos mnyan par7byas na lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten yul la chags pa zhes bya ba'i gnas kyi pha rol na 'dod pa la chags pa zhes bya ba gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang des legs par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ dngul gyi khang pa na 'dug pa ltar rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang yangs pa gser gyi stegs bu can lha'i bya rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba dag 'byung ste/ 'di lta ste/ bya yid du 'thadakyipa dang / sgra kun 'byin pa dang /chu na rgyu ba dang / gser lta bu dag ste/ bya de lta bu dag gis kun tu gang ba 63—152

yin no/ /sa phyogs de na chu bo dang / 'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang / nye ba'i tshal dang yang ldan pa yin no/ /phyogs de nanyebya'i rnam pa 'bum snyed kyis kyang kun tu gang ba yin te/ de na lha rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan bzhi dang /kha cig 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa du rnams kyis dga' bar byed do/ /lha'i mig gis55)gzugs gang dang gang mthong ba de dang de dag 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba mthong ngo / /rna bas sgra gang dang gang thos pa de dag kyang 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba thos so/ /snas dri gang dang gang bsnamasalgepa de dang de dag kun kyang 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba la snom mo/ /lces ro gang dang gang myong (5)bar byed pa de dang de dag kyang 'dod pa sdug pa 6yid du 'ong ba myong ngo / /lus kyis gang dang gang lamacho reg pa de dang de dag kyang 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba la reg par byed do/ /yid kyis gang dang gang la sems pa de dang de dag kyang bo'adod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba la sems shing 'grub par gyuralo11te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sems chags pa de shin tu bde ba dang ldan par gnas so/ /'dod pa la chags pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas ni gzhan dang mi 'dra bar lha'i gnas tshadang ldan te/ bde ba dag myong ba na ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba/ bde bar byas pa shin tu nyams dga' ba/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol la phan pa/ tshul khrims kyi las byas pa ma zad kyi bar du de de na bde ba myong ngo / /de phyis 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i gnas de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan grangs gzhan sku gel myong bar 69wa 153

'gyur ba'i las kyis mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na de las de dang rgyu 'thun par yul chen po shin tu 'byor pa dang ldan pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ ka shi ka dang / ko sa la dag tu rgyal rigs shing sātul chen po lta bu dang / bram ze'i rigs shing sā ②la chen po lta bur skye bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slongasalas kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha'i 'jig rten la rtog par byed de/ legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad pa gang gis phreng thogs kyi gnas yid g.yo ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur pa sems pa yod pa yid gsal bas zhing bzang po mngon par shes pa gus shing sems dang bakhugang gis sangs rgyas sam/ mchod rten nam/ dge 'dun gyi gnas phyag dar legs par byas na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten yid g.yo ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de'i lus sha dang / rus pa dang / chu ser dang bral ba las dri bsung dpag tshad brgyar 'byung la/ ji ltar me long shin tu g.ya' med pa'i nang du thams cad snang ba de ltar lha'i lus de la lha'i ris de na nye bar gnas pa gang yin pa thams cad snang ste/ de ltar legs par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la nye bar spyod do/ /gnas de dag na lha'i tshal bzhi yod de/ 'di lta ste/ skyon med pa'i tshal dang / gsal ba'i tshal dang / dri zhim pa'i tshal dang / me tog man 'o⑧ra ba'i tshal te/ mang po de dag na sdong bu ni bee ḍūrya/ ze ba ni dngul las byas pa'i pad ma'i rdzing yod la/ bya ngang pa dang / kā raṇḍa pa dang / ngur pa sgra 'byin pas gang ba/ me tog mdogashe63—154

dang dri sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams kyis khebs pa 'dam rdzob kyi skyon dang bral ba/chu rnyog pa dang bral ba/ nya lcibs dang bral ba/ chu rtag tu dri zhim pas gang ba yin no/ /tshal de dag na dus tshigs rab tu dga' bar byed pa drugatenyu)yod la/bya dag bya mo dang lhan cig 'khod pa yang snang ste/ rdzing du dong nas dga' bar byed cingadzaparang gis byas pa'i las la spyod do/ /shing sngon pa de dag kyang dus tshigs thams cad du rtag tu me tog gis rgyas la rnyis pa'i skyon dang bral ba phan tshun 'gran pa ltar dus thams cad du me tog rgyas so/ /de ltar legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad pa de/ tshal dang nye ba'i tshal de rnams su lha mo yid du 'ong ba rgyan dang cha byad dang / spud pa sna tshogs thogs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i bde ba dag myong bar byed do/ /sred 5)pa'i yul ba/la rnam par chags shing dga' ba/ yul drug la blo shin tu chags pa de/ chu'i nang na nya rgya'i gseb tu nya chud de nya rgyas bsdus pa ltar bde bas nam chung 5zad kyang skyo bar mi byed de/ de ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las ma zad pa de srid du de na lha'i bde ba rnam pa du ma la spyod do / /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis mi76)rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de rang gi las dang rgyu 'thun par ded dpon chen por gyur te/ shin tu 'byor pa dang ldan pa dang rgyal pos kyang bkur bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha phreng thogs kyi gnas la 69—155

rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha phreng thogs rnams kyi gnas gang na lha 'khod pa tshal dang nye ba'i tshal na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de dag lasatugang gis der skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur pa②/ sems dang ba/ dge 'dun la zhing du shes pa gang gis chos gos bya ba'i phyir se 'bru gcig phul 'kho/ phul nas kyang yang dang yang du sems kyis yongs su spel bar byed/ rjes su dga' bar byed/ bdag nyid la bdag nyid rab tu dga' bar byed na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten tshal dang nye ba'i tshal gyi nang na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas de lha'i tshal dang nye ba'i tshal na ni gnas/bdag nyid gar5gedaga' dgur ni 'chag cing 'gro/ chu la yang mi nub par 'gro ste / 'di lta ste/ thang la 'gro ba bzhin du 'gro la/ de bzhin du bar snang la yang thogs pa med par 'gro'o/ /de ji skad bstan pa'i gnas rnams su lha'i phreng ba dang / gos ni gyon/ shin tu bde ba dang ni ldan/ rang dga' nyams bag tu gnas shing dga' bar ni byed/ tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dang / 'bab chu dang / lteng ka nyamasashedaga' zhing shin tu dri zhim pa sna tshogs kyi nang na lha mo'i tshogs kyis ni yongs su bskor/ nyi ma gnyis pa ltar rang gi gzi brjid kyis 'bar zhing lha'i bde ba rang gis byas pa'i rgyu las byung ba/ rgyu'i stobs dang 'brel pa la nye bar spyod par byed de/ gzhan gyis byas lasnyigazhan spyod pa ni med do/ /rang gis byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la spyod pa/ las kyis⑥nges par 'byung ba'i srog chags rnams legs par byas pas ni lha dang mi rnams kyi 63—156

nang du skye bar 'gyur la nyes par byas pas ni/ sems can dmyal ba dang /yi dgas dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /legs par byas pa'i las kyis der skyes pa de ji srid du legs par byas pa'i las zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de na bde ba la spyod par byed do/ /de phyis de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis 1)mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na(snye/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par skye bo tshal na gnas pa rnams kyi nang na 'byor pa dang ldan zhing gzhan gyis gnod pa med la rang dgar longs spyod par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi5 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha phreng thogs rnams kyi gnas bcu ma lus par brtags nas/ lha gzhan lag na yol go thogs zhes bya ba dag la rtogate nipar byed do/ /lha de rnams kyi gnas gang 5/na gnas pa rang dga' zhing rang gi yid dang 'thun par 'dod pa ji tsam yod snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ 'di ltar lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas kyang bcu yod de(4)/ 'di lta ste/ pad ma'i nang na rgyu ba dang / bung ba'i sgra snyan pa dang / sgra la chags pa dang / dris dregs dga' dang / rlung la spyod pa dang / me tog phreng dga' dang / kun tu lta ba dang / rtag tu dga' ba dang ske/ dri la chags pa dang / spyi gtsug 7)thar te/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas ni bcu po 'di dag yin no/ /sa de rnams na lha dag las so sor byas pa gang gis lha'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur snyam nas des thos pa las 69—157

byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad pa sems bsgoms pa'i yid dang ldan pa gang gis sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo zhes lan gsum brjod na/ de der mthar shin tu mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i las skyed pa yin te/ mi'i gnas skabs kyi rnam par smin pa gang yin pa de nam 'chi ba'i dus byas nas lus dang bral na bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyisheganas pad ma'i nang na rgyu ba zhes bya ba der skye bar 'gyur rol/ /der skyes nas kyang de'i gnas de ni yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i ro shin tu zhim pa la7chags pa'i mig mi 'dzums pa/ lus nyi ma ltar gsal ba/ lha'i 'dod pa dang sdug pa dang yid du 'ong ba la mngon par dga' ba/ bya chu skyar gyi mdog lta bu'i pad ma kun gyis mdzes par byas la/ pad ma de dag nams kyangashezhum par mi 'gyur ba dang / pad ma re re las kyang lha'i dri dpag tshad tsam du 'byung ste/ des lha'i dri de dag thams cad dang / gzhan yang me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dri rnams zil gyis gnon par byed pa dang / bung ba kha dog sna tshogs can kha cig gser gyi bya lta bur 'dug la/ kha cig ma he'i mig gi mdog lta bu dang / kha cig bee ḍūrya'i mdog lta bur 'dug pa dag sgra rnam pa sna tshogs 'byin te/ de'i khyad par ni mi rnams kyis legs par bslabs pa'i pi bang gi sgra 'byin pa na/ shin tu snyanasacing lhag par dga' bar byed pa'i sgra kun du gang bar 'byung ba dag 'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/lha'i 'dod pa la mi yis dper byar med pa'i phyir te/ mi gang gis kyang lha'i sgra mnyan par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang /69—158

'dod chags dang bral ba ma gtogs par de la mi'i 'jug pa'i yul ma yin no/ /'di ltar 'khor los sgyur 1ba ni stobs dang ldan la nadabang po rnams kyang stobs dang ldan pas lha dang mi'i 'dod pa la spyod par nus so/ /'di ltar 'dod chags dang bral ba ni 5de'i dbang po dga' bar 'gyur ba yang med la g.yo ba yang med de/ de 4ltar de na bung ba'i zisgra 'byung ba dag des mnyan par nus sol/ /dud 'gror gyur pa sems rmongs par gyur pa rnams kyi sgra yang de lta bu yin na ske/ 'dod pa la sems chags pa'i lha'i tshogs rnams 7kyi glu dbyangs dang sgra lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ dpe med pa yin la/ 'di ltar sgra la chags par byed pa la yang skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / gzugs dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg bya rnams kyis kyang de dang mi 'thun par skyo bar mi byed do/ /de ltar de sgo du ma de dang / sred pa'i sgo'i thabs du ma'i bde ba de dag la ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las mtho ris su skyes pa zad par ma gyur pa de srid du spyod par byed do/ /de phyis de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma naskyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba 9mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun 10par grong 11khyer du grong gi bdag po shin tu 'byor pa dang ldan pa'am tshong dpon du 'gyur la gzhan du yang rgyu dang rkyen de dang gzhi des mthar mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de / lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des 15thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha rnams kyi gnas bung ba /sgra snyan zhes bya ba 1 ji 69wa 159

ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na tshul khrims dang ldan zhing shes rab dang ldan pa sems pas bsgoms pa'i snying nyudang / snying rjes brlan pa'i yid sems can la phan par zhugs pas mchod rten la rol mo'i sgra dang dris mchod na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas bung ba'i sgra snyan du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa de sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs dang / bro gar dang / dgon⑧pa dang / 'jo ba dang / nyams dga' ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bde ba la spyod pa pad ma'i dris myos pa'i lha mo glu dbyangs thos na yid 'phrog par byed pa'i dbyangs la ni nyan/ bde bar gnas pa'i kun dga' ra ba na nye bar spyod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs du ma dag ni dbyangs kyi sgra 'byin/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs 'dres pa'i dri'i ngadasakyis ni7lus la reg cing rin po che tshode)du mas mdzes par byas pa'i ri rab kyi rtse mo rnams la sdug pa thos na shin tu dga' bar byed pa rnams dang lhan cig rnam par rgyu zhing gnas la dga' bar byed do/ /de ltar legs par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la nye bar spyod pa mngon par mthong nas/ dge slongs byedage ba'i las la stod cing 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ las 'di dag ni lha yi yul/ /gsum gyi them pa'i skas su gyur2)/ /de la 'dzeg pa'i mi rnams ni/ /lha yul bde ba 'byung bar 'gro/ /ngag la rnam pa bzhi bsdams te/ /lus las byung ba rnam spugasum mo / /them skas bdun la 'dzegs nas su/ /lha yul gsum du 'gro bar byed/ /tshul khrims spyod pa shin tu bde/ /nor spyod de ltar bde ba min/ /nor gyis mi 69—160

ni 'grib byed la/ /tshul khrims kyis ni 'grib mi byed/ /des ni mi dag legs par byed/ /so so dag tu'ang de mdzes so/ /de bas mtho ris 'gro ba la/ /thub mchog rnams kyis dge bar bsngags/ /skyes bu dge ba spyod pa rnams/ /skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba bzhin/ /lha yi 'jig rten du mar de/ /bde ba rnams kyi 'byung khung mchog /rang gi lus las byung ba yi/ /'od kyis de dag 'bar ba na/ /rang gi las kyis bskul 1ba rnams/ /mtho ris gnas na dga' bar byed / /rtag tu dga' bar gnas pa dang / /rtag tu bde bar gnas pa yi/ /lha gang yin pa lha yi gnas/ /de na tshul khrims byed rgyu yin/ /tshul ldan de yi tshul khrims ni/ /du ma'ang legs par bsrungs pa yin/ /'bras bu mtho ris smin par 'gyur/ /de bas tshul khrims rtag tu spyod/ /tshul khrims mtho ris skas yin la/ /bde rgyu 'byung ba'i gnas yin no/ /tshul khrims spangs pa'i mi dag ni/ /gang du'ang bde ba mi 'thob bo/ /tshul khrims chu ni dang ba dang / /kun du rnam par gang ba yis/ /khrus byas mi dag lha yi gnas/ /lha yi 'jig rten 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lha yi phreng ba rgyan rnams dang / /lha yi bde ba ldan pa gang ske/ /de kun dge ba'i rgyu las byung / /lha yi gnas na dga' bar byed/ /gang zhig lha mos yongs bskor dang / /gang zhig nyi zla 'dra ba rnams/ /de kun dge ba'i rgyu las byung / /lha dag lha yi nang na dga'/ /gang zhig bsams na 'byung byed pa/ /byung nas kyang ni 'grib med cing / /dge ba rtag 4tu 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de kun dge ba'i rgyu las byung / /gang zhig tshul khrims rjes su 'jug /bde ba dag ni grangs med la/ /thams cad du ni 'phel byed la/ /mi yis thams cad 'thob par 5'gyur/ /rtag tu dge ba spyod pa'i mi/ /rgyal 69—161

pos kyang ni rtag tu bkur/ /dge bas mi ni dge bar 'gyur/ /de bas tshul khrims rtag tu spyod/ /dge ba spyod pa rtag tu dul/ /'byung po kun la snying brtse mchog /rtag tu sbyin dang byams ldan pa/ /lha dag 'du ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /srog gcod pa 1las ldog pa dang / /sems can kun la snying brtse mchog /yang dag las kyi mtha' ldan pa/ /lha dag 'du ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /ma byin chunga'azad len mi byed/ /sbyin la'ang ri de ni rtag tu dga'/ /blo ldan blo gros dbang po zhi/ /lha dag 'du ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /gang zhig log par g.yem dang bral//yang dag lam la rtag tu dga'/ /mya ngan 'das la som nyi med/ /lha rnams kyi ni nang du 'gro/ /gang zhig 'thungs na skyes bu dag /yid la mi dga' mang byed pa/ /chang spangs shin tu brtan (༄pa dag /lha rnams kyi ni nang du 'gro/ /bde ba du ma skyed 5byed cing / /thams cad dbugs ni 'byin byed pa/ /tshul khrims legs par spyad bya zhing / /nyes pa byas pa'ang rnam par spongs/ /de ltar dge slong des bde ba 'byung ba rnam pa du ma dag mngon par mthong nas bung ba dzisgra snyan gyi lha rnams la mngon par bstod do/ /de ltar lha de dag lha'i 'jig rten du gtogs pa'i bung ba mang po rnams kyis sgra snyan pa 'byin pa na/ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las byas shing bsags pang zad par ma gyur pa de srid du sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya khyad par du sdug pa dag myong 8bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma po)skyes la / mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 69—162

'thun par me tog gi phreng ba bzang po thogs shing rtag tu bde ba dang ldan pa dang ske/ gnod pa med par 1gnas pa dang / yun ring du 'tsho ba dang /longs spyod dang ldan par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas sgra la chags pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las 2byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing sems shin tu bsgoms pa gang gis sangs rgyas gzi byin dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa 3la gdugs phul na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sgra la chags pa zhes bya ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang lha'i bde ba dang ldan pa de gser dang / dngul dang / bai ḍūrya'i ri rnam pa sna tshogs la rgyu ba dag la bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ste/ lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba 'khor dang bcas pa dag rin po che sna bdun gyi ri'i rtse mo rnams su rgyu zhing rol mo'i tshal cazhes bya ba'i tshal der 'jug par byed do/ /lha'i phreng ba dang / gos gyon pa me tog gi phreng ba dang / phye ma dang / byug pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dris rnam par brgyan pa de 5res 'ga' spos kyi tshal zhes bya ba shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis tshomadzes par byas pa'i tshal du yang 'jug par byed do/ /tshal de na chu bo dang / snye 'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang / pad ma'i rdzing dang / shing ljon pas mdzes par byas pa yin te/ rnam pa ji tsam du bya 'dab chags kyis mdzes par byas pa'i rnam pa de tsam du 'od gang gis sdug pa 69wa 163

lta bur lha'i 'od stong dang / 'od kyi rnam pa gzhan yang sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ btsod ma'i mdog tu 'byung ste/ tshal de kha dog bzang po yin no/ /las kyi mtha' spyad pa la zhugs pa'i tshal de na me tog du mas bsgos pa dri shin tu zhim pa'i dri ngad dang po'inyerdzi 'byung ste/ gang gi tshe rdzi des lo ma de dag la phog par gyur pa de'i tshe rdzis phog pa'i lo ma phan tshun reg pa las rol mo'i sgra 'byung ste/ de'i khyad par ni lha ma yin gyi gnas na spyod pa'i rol mo dag gisakhubacu drug gi char yang mi phod pa'i rnam pa de lta bu dag 'byung ngo / /gang gi tshe lo ma re re la phog pa de'i tshe yang rol mo'i sgra shin tu chags su rung ba dag ③'byung ste / de sil snyan yan lag lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur la/ yul shin tu nyams dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis myos so/ /de nas yang lo ma'i rol mo'i sgra des sred pa la chags shing dga' ba bag med pa brgya snyed la gnas par byed do/ /sgra la chags pa/ sgra la zhen pa/ sgras bslus pa de/ ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las byas shing bsags pa zad par ma gyur pa de srid du/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya khyad par du sdug pa dag myong bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par rol mo la mngon par dga' bar 'gyur zhing nor dang / 'bru dang / khyim dang chung ma shin tu 'byor ba dang / yun ring du 'tsho ba dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du yang bkur bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu 69wa 164

rnam par smin pa shes pa de lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ der lha dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur ming ni ci zhes bya snyam nas des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na lha'i 'jig rten na lha rnams kyi gnas dris dregs dga' zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der 1sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ sems shin tu tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ sems 2yongs su bsgoms pa gang gis mchod rten gyi bum pa'am gdugs la dri chab phul na / de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dris dregs dga'i lha rnams kyi nang dus skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang lha'i bde ba dang ni ldan / bde ba dpe med pa'i kha zas la ni rten/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i zas kyis ni tshim / lus dang yid kyi gdung ba dang ni bral/ lha'i phreng ba dang / gos gyon pa rtag tu sil snyan yan lags5lngas rtsen cing / dgod 6pa dang / dga' ba dang ske/ rtse ba'i grogs dang ldan pa lha mo'i tshogs rnams ni glu dbyangs len/nyin gcig gcig 7bzhin rgyun mi chad 8par ri sul las chu'i shugs 'bab pa ltar bde ba rnams ni 'phel/ nor bu mthon ka dang / spug dang / dngul gyi ri'i rtse mo rnams su dga' bar byed cing / chu bo dang / 'bab chu dang /lteng ka rnam pa sna tshogs ni mthong / tshal gyi nang na gnas pa bya dang khu byug rnams kyang mthong ste/ lta ba du ma'i zi lang bar lta ba/ tshal dang nags tshal yid du 'ong ba rnams su lta bar byed kyang / sems tshim pa med pa dag lha'i 'jig rten de na gnas so/ /chu bo dang / 'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang /tshal dang nye ba'i tshal rnams 9na mtho ris kyi chu'i 1 ro gang dang gang 'byung ba 69—165

dag ni 'di ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na legs par byas pa'i las kyis dgun chang dang sbyar ba'i chang dang / sha kha ra'i chang gi ro 'byung ba rnam pa ①de lta bur 'byung ngo / /de ltar legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad pa de/ lha'i 'jig rten de na ji srid du de'i legs par byas pa'i las zad par ma gyur pa de srid du lha mo'i tshogs du mas yongs su bskor ba dag dang dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/de las na/de dang rgyu 'thun par bran khyim bdog cing nor dang 'bru mang po kun ri cinas gang bar 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge rnyong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas rlung gi rgyu zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing / sems yongs su bsgoms pa'i snying 4dang ldan pa gang gis tsha bas gdungs pa'i dge slong rnams la rlung yab kyis rlung g.yabs te/ gang gis rlung 'byung ba reg na bde ba ku shi ra'i pa dri dang 'dres pas dge slong shin tu tsha bas gdungs pa de rnams rlung des bsam gtan dang / kha ton 'don pa dang 'jug par bya ba dag byed par nus na / sbyin bdag de las 6byas pa'i rkyen des lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten rlung la spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der 69wa 166

skyes nas kyang legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad pa de la rlung dri zhim pa dpe med pa ldang ngo / /gang rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi rlung dpe med pa ldang ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ lha'i ris gzhan nas rlung langs pa'i dri 'bum 'gyur 1du zhim lan/ shin tu bsil bar yang ldang ste/ rnam par smin pa bzang po gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga 'gyur 3du 'byung ngo / /der rgyal chen bzhi pa rnams kyi rlung ni nyis 'gyur cadu 'byung ngo ske/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa rnams las lhag par sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi sum 'gyur 5du 'byung ngo / /sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams las lhag par 'thab bral ba 6rnams kyi bzhi 'gyur 7du 'byung ngo / /'thab bral ba rnams las lhag par dga' ldan pa rnams kyi lnga 'gyur 8du 'byung ngo / /dga' ldan pa rnams las 9lhag par 'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi drug 'gyur 1 du 'byung ngo / /de dag pas kyang lhag par gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams kyi yang 'byung ste/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi las kyi 11bye brag las 'gro ba'i ris kyi bye brag tu 'gyur ro/ /las byas pa de dag mngon par mthong nas/ legs par byas pa'i las des rlung la spyod pa'i lha de rnams la/ lha'i ris drug na rlung langs pa dpe med pa dri zhim pa bde ba gang yin pa de dag ldang ngo / /rlung de dag gi mthu gcig cig 1 bshad par bya ste/ 'di ltar de'i mthu thams cad ni bshad 1 par mi nus so/ /lha de rnams kyi rlung dga' dgur byed pa ldang ste/ de ni gang gi tshe rol mo'i sgra 'byung bar 'dod na de'i tshe rlung de ri dang nags tshal gyi gseb tu song nas ji ltar de lha mos rol mo byas pa chung zad kyang 1 snyan 15par mi 'gyur ba de lta bur ldang ngo //gal te shin tu dri zhim par 'dod na de gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i ris man 69wa 167

chad kyi mdog dpe med pa dang ldan pa dag las langs nas lha de rnams kyi drung du ldang bar byed do①/ /gal te bsil ba 'dod na de ji ltar de dag gi lus la bzod pa rnam pa de lta bu'i bsil ba ldang ngo / /gal te yul gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod dam/ de bzhin du bee ḍūrya'i ri rab kyi rtse mo lta bar 'dod dam/ de bzhin du dngul gyi'am/ de bzhin du 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi'am/ de bzhin du shel gyi'am/ de bzhin du me tog dang / 'bras bu dngas / chu bo dang ske/ 'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang / tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal bya chadang me tog nyams dga' ba'i yul sna tshogs lta bar 'dod pa dang / lha mo sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te 'gro bar 'dod pa'i lha rnams la rlung sgra dang / dri dang /bde ba rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa de dag ldang bar byed do/ /tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dang / dka' thub kyi tshal dang / ri khrod rnam pa sna tshogs su snga ma bzhin khyer bar yang byed de/ de ltar rlung 'ong ba dang 'gro ba dag 'dod pa lnga la dga' ba'i lha rnams dang lhan cig dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed do/ /phrag dog dang 'thab mo dag gis skyo ba med pa/ phan tshun grogs su gyur pa/ phan tshun gnod pa med pa rnams yid gcugasasnyishing gnas de dag la yid zhugs pa/ rang gi las kyis bsgyur ba rnams dga' bar byed do//lha'i 'jig rten na lha rang gi las tha ma dang 'bring dang bzang po rnams kyis rjorgya'i 'bur lta bur las khyi 'bras bu 'byung ba ni/ ji ltar rlung phrag dog dang ser sna dang bral ba'i shugs 'byung 4yel/ shugs zad nas sa la 'bab pa de ltar ji srid du las kyi rnam pa tha ma dang / 'bring dang / bzang po legs par byas pa'i rnam pa de srid du 'byung ba'i shugs spyad la/ de nas yang legs par 69—168

byas pa'i las zad nas lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams ni las kyi skye gnas las 1)skye zhing las la rtonas pa yin la/ ji ltar las byas pa de ltar 'gro bar 'gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi skye ba ni rgyu med pa las byung ba ma yin no/ /dge slong des 3las de dag mthong nas 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ji ltar nyi ma'i rjes su dus 'gyur zhing / /ji ltar dus kyi rjes su zhing rnams skye/ /de ltar las kyi rjes su skye ba 'byung / /rgyu med pa las skye ba 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang gis lus can bcings pa rnams/ /tshe rabs gzhan ni stong dag tu/ /rnam par chags pa mang po'i las/ /rnam gsum lu gu rgyud kyis bcings/ /ji ltar sbrang rtsi dug dang zas/ /'dres pa yongs su spong bar byed/ /de ltar lha yi 4bder gtogs 5)pa/ /mthar ni zhiltung ba rnam par spongs/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal 'chi ba na/ /bsod nams zad de dman pas ni/ /rang gi chung ma rnams kyis spangs/ /de 'dra ba ni dpe med do/ /legs byas zad de dman pa ni/ /sgron ma 'bar ba zad pa ltar/ /lha khyod gang du 'gro 'gyur zhes/ /sdug bsngal chen po rab tu skyed/ /sred pa'i dug gis rnam bsregs shing / /mya ngan gyis ni sems nyams te/ lus dang ngag gi spyod dman pa/ /lha ni ltung ba dag gis 'jigs/ /'dod rnams shin tu slu byed de/ /ji lta ji ltar bde myangs pa/ /de lta de ltar yongs su gtong / /de dag sdug bsngal rab tu che/ /lha yi yul nas ltung ba na/ /sdug bsngal rab tu skye ba gang / /de yi khyad par sems can dmyal/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /sred pas 'khor ba kun byas par/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rnams kyis dkrugs / /srid pa'i sgrog gis bcings pa yi/ /sems can rnams ni ngan 69—169

'gror 'gro/ /lha yi 'jig rten 'chi ba'i mtha'/ /de bzhin sa steng 'chi ba'i mtha' / /'khor ba las ni mi 'byung bas/ /sdug bsngal mthong nas rnam par spongs / /skye bo bag med dga' ba gang / /de ni thar pa mi 'thob ste/ /bag med dug gis rmongs 1)pa ni/ /de la mya ngan 'das pa ring / /bag med dgra yi mchog yin pas/ /bag med rnams la chags ma byed/ /shin tu bag med lha rnams ni/ /yang dang yang du dmyal bar ltung / /gnas gsum 'khrul 'khor 'khor ba ltar/ /'khrul 'khor las kyis 'khyam par byed/ /de bas sred pa'i chags pa spongs/ /'dod chags bral ba zhi ba'i gnas/ /de ltar dge slong des lha'i 'jig rten gyi mtha' ltung bar mthong nas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral lo/ /rlung la spyod pa'i lha de rnams kyi mi rtag pa dang / bde ba de dag la las kyi rgyus bskyed cing mi rtag pa nyid dang 'brel ba yin pa lta zhes rnam par dpyod sapar byed do/ /lha de rnams kyang ji srid du de'i legs par byas pa'i las zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de nar dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar dus ji srid du legs par byas pa'i las yod pa dang 'od gsal ba 'byung ba'i dus de srid du lha rnams lha'i 'jig rten na spyod do / /de zad nas lhung sbyorabar 'gyur la/ lhung nas kyang yang sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par rlung gis bdas nas/ 'gro ba gargya mtshor spyod cing 'tsho ba'i ded dpon du 'gyur ba mthong ngo // //'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag kyi)pa/ bam po nyer bdun 69—170

pa / de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des 1 thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas me tog phreng dga' zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur nasnyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na /tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing lus dang ngag gi las kyi mtha' yang dag pa sems pas yongs su bsgoms pa'i sems dang ldan pa gang gis tsha ba'i dus su dge 'dun la chu ril ba gang phul ba'am/ lam du zhugs pa'am/ 'brog dgon par zhugs pa dag la yang chu ril ba gang byin na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten me tog phreng dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de'i lus bde ba dang sgeg 4pa sna tshogs su ni spyod/ lha mo'i sil snyan gyi sgra 'byin cing dgon pa sna tshogs kyi nang du ni zhugs / bai ḍūrya dang / gser dang / dngul gyi ri rab kyi gshong na rtsen pa 5dag dang lhan cig ni gnas/ ri khrod rnam pa sna tshogs na lha mo dang ni lhan cig 'khod / rlung dri zhim pos reg pa'i lus 6me tog phreng ba thogs pa/ 'bab chu dang ske/ lteng gas brgyan pa'i yul rnams na 7dga' bar byed cing lha mo mang po'i nang na spyod pa nas lo 'bum phrag du ma song ngo / /de ltar gnas pa de res 'ga' tshal 'bab chu zhes bya ba na gnas te tshal de na dga' bar byed do/ /tshal de ni bee ḍūrya'i shing ljon pa la gser gyi 'dab ma yod pa dang / gser gyi shing la bee ḍūrya'i 'dab ma yod pa dang / dngul gyi shing la gser gyi 'dab ma dag yod de/ tshal de'i nang du zhugs pa de rtag par yid rab tu dga' la9/ lus 69—171

rang gi 'od dang ldan pa yin no/ /de'i legs par byas pa'i las des shing de dag brtol71)ba las mtho ris dang 'thun pa'i skom 'byung stetsho/ skom de'i khyad par ni mi'i rgyan7chang dang sbyar ba'i chang dang / sha kha ra'ikhuchang dag 'bras bu pi tsu man da'i ro dang mtshungs te/ skom de ni lha'i ro dang mdog dang stobs dang ldan pa yin no/ /de'i dri dpag tshan⑧du yang 'byung ste bya'i tshogs lus gser dang dngul gyi mdog lta bu yin rab tu dga' ba kun gyis skom de 'thungs nas tshal de na mesgra yid du 'ong ba 'byin cing kun du 'gengs so/ /shing de dag gi sdong po brtol nas skom 'byung ba de la bung ba'i tshogs 'ub 'ub 'du ste/skom kha cig gi mdog ni gser lta bu yin/ kha cig gi mdog ni bee ḍūrya lta bu yin / kha cig gi mdog ni spug lta bu yin/ kha cig gi mdog ni pad ma rā ga lta bu yin/ kha cig gi mdog ni ma rgad ⑦lta bu yin te/ skom de dag kun nas byung nas rigabrug pa chu bo ltar 'bab bo/ /skom gyi chu bo de'i ming yang mtha' med 'bab ces bya stelta/ chu bo'i rgyar dpag tshad gnyis yod pa'i 'gram gnyi gatshwa byenyams dga' la/ 'gram gnyi gatshwa)lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing glu len la gser gyi pad mas khebs pa 'bab bo/ /de nas lha mo'itshwanyetshogs kyis 'thungs pa dang yid rab tu dga' ste/ dgodamanyepar byed/ rtse bar byed/phan tshun gser gyi pad ma'i sdongachabu bee ḍūrya rnams kyis masgeg par byed/ rtse bar byed/ dgodasapar byed do/ /shing rta sna tshogs la zhon pa rnams rgyug par byed cing dgod par byed la/ lha'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas phan tshun 'thor bar byed do/ /lha de 3 mornams kyi pad ma'i rdzing yod pa de ni kun nas bsten pa zhes bya la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba dpe med pa yin te/ legs par byas 63—172

pa'i las kyis bsgyur ba'i lha de rnams ji srid du de'i 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las zad par ma gyur pa de srid du gnas so/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis51)sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal bstonamanyam par mi'i nang du skyes na(gu / de las de dang rgyu 'thun par bkres pa dang skom pa yong ye med cing 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i yul du skye la/ nor dang shin tu ldan pa dang skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par kyibyed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas kun tu lta ba zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo /der sems can dag las gang gis 5skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyad par gyur pa/ sems pas yongs su bsgoms pa'i snying gis brlanas pa/ skyo ba med cing shin tu dga' ba'i sems pa gang bdag la phan pa med kyang / tshul khrims 'chal pa'i nad pa'i rim gro byed na de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten kun tu lta ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang lha'i phreng ba dang / gos gyon pa rab tu dga' ste 57)lha'i 'dod 8pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor pa'i bde ba dang ni ldan/yid rtag tu dga' ba lha'i 9'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams dang ldan pa dag skyed mos tshal nas skyed mos tshal du ni rgyu/ dga' dgur gnas pa grogs sdug gu lha 69—173

mo'i tshogs du mas bskor 19)cing yongs su spyod par ni byed/ nyi ma'i 'od ltar ni gsal/ dge ba ni rgya cher 'phel/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis ni mchod/ri rab rin po che du ma'i 'od kyis gsal bar byas shing rab tu 'bar ba dag la ni gnas/ gos tshon can rnam pa sna tshogs ni bgos/ mtho ris dang 'thun pa'i rin po che du ma dag gi rgyan gdags par bya ba ni btags/ tshal na rnam par rgyu ba'i lhas bsams pa'i tshal dkrigs pa sna tshogs dag na geni gnas/pad ma'i rdzing dang / lteng ka dang / chu'i dngorasne)dang / 'bab chu dang /chu bo dang / 'bab chu'i rgyun dang / stegs sna tshogs dag la rnam par rgyu ba na/rang gi las ri4)rnams las kyi bya ba byed do/ /de ltar de yongs su rgyu ba na/phyogs gzhan zhig na tshal dril bu g.yer ku'i dra bas gtibs shing gser gyi lan kun bres (5)pa zhig des mthong ste/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs gnas pa/ bya'i tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa 'byin pa rnams kyis ni kun tu 56cigang / rlung gis phog nas rab tu g.yos pa'i dril bu g.yer ma'i mo sgra ni drag tu 'khrol/ nyi ma 'bum snyed kyi 'od dang ni ldan/ ri rab las byung ba gser gyi ri bdun la 'di lta ste/ shin tu mtho dang / rab sbyor dang / char 8ridaga'amakha dang / klus lngabartol dang / rab chags gsal dang / rin chen char 'bebs dang / rgyu skar phreng gis yongs su bskor ba/ dril bu g.yer ku'i dra bas gtibs hu1pa'i tshal der 'jug par byed do/ /rnam pa de lta bu'i tshal lha'i phreng ba la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa de na/ lha mo tshal gyi gsab gseb na rgyu7rtezhing rtse ba gang yin pa de dag 'od zer 'bum snyed 'byung ba ltar tshal de na 32snang ngo / /shing ljon pa'i bar bar na 'khod pa'i lha de dag gis de rnams mthong nas/ de nas yang 69wa 174

'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la blo rnam par chags pa dag blta ba'i phyir de'i drung du 'dong zhing shin tu rgyug par byed de1/ gser gyi pad ma rnams kyis de dag dang rtse bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed/ dgod 2par byed/ sgeg par byed la/ rol mo'i sgra rnams kyis kyang shin tu dga' bar byed do/ /de ltar 'dod pa la blo rnam par chags pa de mig lha'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis chog mi shes so/ / rna ba /sgra snyan pa gsal ba yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis chog mi shes so/ /sna dri zhim pa bsung che ba yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis chog mi shes so/ /lce ro zhim pa bro ba mang la 4yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis chog mi shes so/ /pags 5pa reg bya bde ba 'jam pa yang ba yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis chog 6mi shes te/sred 7pa drug gi mes yongs su bskor ba de kun nas sreg par byed do/ /de ltar chog mi shes pa de dge slong des mngon par mthong nas 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ lha yi 'jig rten kun nas su/ /sred pa'i me yis yongs su bskor//rmongs pa 8'dod pa'i dbang song ba/ /chags pa dbang med sred par byed/ /ji lta ji ltar shing rnyed na/ /de lta de ltar sreg 9pa 'phel/ /ji lta ji ltar bde thob na/ /de lta de ltar sred me 'phel/ /shing mes sreg pa'i nyes pa rnams/ /mi yis yongs su spang nus kyi/1 /'jig rten srid mes sreg pa ni/ /yongs su spang bar mi nus so/ /chu bo chen po rgal 'dod la/ /chu srin gyis ni 'jigs pa gang / /de dag bde ba'i mthar phyin na/ /srid pas de la gnod mi 'gyur/ /sred pa'i zhags las 1 rnam grol zhing / /'dod chags zhe sdang spong ba po12/ /nyes sdig las ni grol ba 1 gang / /mkhas pa de ni mya ngan bral/ /gang zhig tshul khrims srung ba nyid/ /mtho ris de la yid zhugs na/ /de dag tshul khrims sdig 69—175

dang bcas/ /zas dang dug ni 'dres pa bzhin/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su / /sred pas bslus pa'i mi rnams ni/ /shin tu rmongs pas7de mi gtongashe/ /yid ni gti mug dbang du song / /skom gyis gdungs pa'i khur tsa ba/ /lan tshwa'i chu ni 'thungs pa ltar/ /sredas pas bslus pa'i sems can rnams/ /sred pa nyid kyi rjes su 'brang / /skye bo skad cig tshim byed la/ /skad cig gis ni skom byed pal/ /skyes bu tha ma sred pa yis/ /gdungs pa lam gol tshol ba bzhin / /de bas sred pa bsten mi⑧bya/ /sred pa de ni bsten par dka'ayi/ /sred pa'i dbang du song ba'i mi/ /'khor ba las ni 'grolate⑦mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig bde ba bla na med/ /bsam gtan skyed mos tshal la dga'/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong ston pa/ /de dag bde ba de bzhin 'gyur/ /bde ba bla na med pa rnams/ /lha yul spyod pa'i skye bo dag /sred pa'i zhags pas drangs nas su/ /yang dang yang du dmyal bar 3)ltung / /'chi mtha' dang por dge ba sminal/ /yang dag lam ni ston mdzad pas/ /sred la rtag tu sten byed pa/ /'di yis sdug bsngal tsha zhes gsungs/ /de ltar dge slong des lha'i 'jig rten 'dod pa'i dba' hu )rlabs kyis bdas shing 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mngon par mthong nas (spe'akhor ba la yid byung ngo / /de ltar lha'i de jil srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du gnas kun tu lta ba dag la dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la / mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ las de dang rgyu 69—176

'thun par bu dang / chung ma dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / rtag tu ldan zhing shin tu 'byor bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa des/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi 1gnas la rtog napar byed de / des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas rtag tu dga' ba zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing sems pa gsal ba'i snying dang ldan pa gang gis rgyal pos dgasad par bya ba btson cara'i nang du bcug pa las nor rdzas thams cad phul nas/ de thar bar byas sam/de bzhin du rgyal po'i bu'am/ de dang 'thun pa dag la phul nas de thar bar byas la/ de las nor rdzas sna 'ga' yang len par mi byed de/ snying rjes brlan pa'i snying gis sems can rnams la phan pa kho na byed cing legs par byas na / de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten rtag tu dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang lha de rnams ngo bo nyid kyis yid rab tu dga' ba yin la/ de dag pas kyang de brgya 'gyur 5du yid rab tu dga' bar 'gyur te/ las de dang rgyu 'thun par 'bras bu 'brel pas rgyu dang 'thun par 'bras bu 'byung ngo / /lha'i 'jig rten der skyes pa de lha mo'i tshogs mang pos ni yongs su bskor/ glu dbyangs dang / bro gar dang /bzhad gad dang / rtsed mo dang / dga' dgur spyod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ni mtha' 'khor te/ nye bar spyod cing ri rab dang / ri dang / ri phug dang /69—177

ri khrod rnams su ni rgyu/ de bee ḍūrya'i rdo leb bzang po reg na shin tu bde ba rnams kyi steng na rang dgar 3)ni spyod/ chu bo dang / 'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang ske/ tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal rnams su shin tu bde ba dang ldan pa dag dga' bar byed/ bde ba de'i khyad par ni 'khor los sgyur (ba'i bde bas 'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ris 'thun pa de dang /sha dang / rus pa dang / chu ser dang bral ba de'i phyir bde'o/ /lha'i rin po che'i phreng ba dang / gos du ma gyon pa me tog brgyus pa dang / bgo ba sna tshogs kyis lus brgyan pa de/ ri rab kyi drung dag na rgyu bar byed de/ gal te gser gyi ri zom la 'dzegs ri rin gser de'i mthus de gser lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gal te bai ḍūrya'i ri /zom la 'dzegs na bee ḍūrya de'i chosamathus bee ḍūrya'i mdog lta bur 'gyur te/ bdag nyid mtsho'i nang du zhugs pa ltar gyur kyang 'dam rdzab kyis gos pa lta bur ni mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te shel gyi ri zom la 'dzegs na shel gyi 'od des de zla ba gnyis pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gal te dngul gyi ri zom la 'dzegs na dngul de'i mthus de'i yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kha ba dang me tog ku mu da ltar 'gyur te/ de ltar lha mo'i tshogs kyis ri noyongs su bskor ba de / sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal rnams su dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed cing / lha'i bde ba dpe med pa dag )myong bar byed do/ /de ltar de rnam par spyod pa na 42)shing ljon pa du mas mdzes par byas pa/ lha'i nyams dga' bar byed pa'i tshal zhes bya ba zhig rgyang ring po nas mthong ba dang / der lha de dag 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi shing rta la zhon nas 'gro bar byed do/ /tshal de yang bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra 'byin cing 69wa 178

tshal gyi lcug ma gzhon nu 'phyang ba dag tu shing rtas phyin pa dang / bya lha'i skad du rtse ba zhes bya ba lha rnams dang smra ba 'thun pa dag lha de'i dge ba'i las kyi mthus bskul ba dang / 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ dga' bar byed pa'i las rnams dag /skyes bu gang zhig 'dir byed pa/ /de yi las kyi rnam smin ni/ /legs par yongs su smin par 'gyur/ /bde ba thob pa'i lha de dag /bag med pa la ma bsten 1na/ /de ni bde las bde thob cing / /mya ngan 2'das pa'i rjes su 'gro/ /bde ba'i mtha' de zad 'gyur zhing / /'di la rtag dang ther zug med/ /de thob gzhal med khang rnams la/ /skyes bu mchog rnams chags ma byed/ /bde mtha' rtag tu lhung 3'gyur zhing / /bde la rtag pa nyid med de/ /rgyu de thams cad rig nas su/ /yid la nges par legs par byos / /bsags pa thams cad tha mar zad/ /mtho ba'i mtha' 4ni tha mar rnyil5te/ /'du ba'i mtha' ni tha mar 'bral/ /'tsho ba'i mtha' ni tha mar 'chi/ / skyes pa 6rtag tu 'chi 'gyur zhing / /de la rtag pa nyid med de/ /khams gsum dag tu sngon byung zhe'am/ /phyi nas 'byung ba nyid med do/ /ji ltar nyi ma 'char ba dang / /nub par 'gyur 7ba rab tu mngon/ /de ltar skyes pa 8thams cad kyi/ /tha mar 'chi ba gnas pa yin/ /chos rnams kyi ni ngo bo nyid/ /skye dang 'jig 9pa 'di shes nas/ /bag med yid la ma byed cig /bag med dug gi mchog yin no/ /bag 1 yod 'chi med gnas yin la/ /bag med 'chi ba'i 11gnas yin no/ /bag yod 'chi bar mi 'gyur la/ /bag med rnams ni rtag tu 'chi/ /ji ltar dug dang ji ltar me/ /srog chags bag med de bzhin te / /bag med myos pa'i sems can rnams/ /sdug las sdug bsngal de 'gro'o/ /69wa 179

rtag tu bag yod mi rnams ni/ /'jig rten kun gyis phyag byas shing / /gang na bag med mi gnas pa/ /zhi ba mchog tu 'gro bar byed/ /de kun mtha' ni zad 'gyur te/ /rmongs pa gang zhig mi rig pa/ /de ni phyi nas 'chi 'gyur te/ /ma byas don med gdung bar byed/ /rtag tu bdag nyid dga' 'dod na/ /'chi ba'i bar du dge ba byos/ /chos spyod bde ba yin no zhes/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gdams7)pa yin/ /rgyu yi de nyid rnam ston pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'khor ba kun/ /rtag tu mi rtag mi brtan la/ /'gyur zhing tsha bar rtag tu gsungs / /de nas lha des bya de rnams kyi tshig thos nas/ yang dag par bsams te yid la yang dga' ba bskyed pa dang / sngon gyi tshe'i 'bras bu dran nas yud tsam zhig bag med pa la ma zhugs so/ /mos pa'i srab skyogs kyis yid de 'dzin par byed de/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg bya yid du 'ong ba rnams la bag med pa ma skyes so/ /de nas yang yid mi brtan pa de lha'i bde ba'i dbang du gyur te/ ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba de ma zad kyi bar du/ de yul sdug pa de rnams la spyod par byed de/de phyis lha yul de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang ske/ dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal bsnyemanyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par nams kyang5kyebacings par mi 'gyur zhing / rtag tu bde ba dang ldan la7nyam nga ba rnams las thar par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/63—180

des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas dri la chags pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ skyes bu tshul khrims dang ldan pa sems pas yongs su bsgoms pa'i snying dang yid shin tu dang ba/ sems rnyog pa med par gyur pa/gzhan la gnod pa med pa gang gis sangs rgyas sam/ chos sam dge 'dun la zhing chen por shes nas/ gos shin tu dri zhim pa rnams kyis 1mchod pa byas la legs par byas so snyam du yang sems na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dri la chags pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang shin tu bde ba dang / rang gi 'od dngaldan pa dang / sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pas yid rab tu dga' zhing dga' dgur spyod pa de dus ring mo zhig 'das so/ /dus ring po 'das pa de yang yul gyi bde ba des lha de dag gis mi rig ste/ gang bdag gi 2dus 'di 'das so zhes dbang po dang bde ba mi brtan pa thogs nom med pa'i dus nas zhugs pa'i yul rnams la chog mi shes pa rnams kyis mi rig go/ /de ltar snying la chags pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dang phye ma dang / byug pas lus bskus pa de/ tshal gyi bar bar dag na rgyu bar byed la/ shing ljon pa mang po'i 'od kyis brgyan pa/ chu bo dang / stegs dang ske/ tshal dang / skyed mos tshal dag gis brgyan pa'i yul nyams dga' ba'i tshal rnams la sten 4par byed pa/ 'dod pa mang po la snying chags pa dag yul gyi bde ba des lha'i 'jig rten gyi mtha' 'di ltung bar khong du mi chud do/ /de ltar yul gyi sred pas yongs su bslus pa de/ ji srid du 'dod pa 5sdug pa yid 69—181

du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du lha'i 'jig rten de dag na dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang ske/ dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par yul rtag tu bsil bar skye bar 'gyur te/ yul gnod pa med pa dang / mtshon cha dang / dgon pa dang /lo nyes 'byung ba dang bral ba'i yul rnams su skye la/ skye bo kun gyis mchod par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pa'am nyu)lha'i mig gis lha lagashen yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas spyi gtsug thar ces bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ rgyal po la gnod pa byed pa'i mi spyi gtsugs nas bzung ste spyangs cingapa dang / sdug bsngal ba las gang gnyegis de thar bar byas na/de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten spyi gtsug thar zhes bya ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas gsum gyi nang na de'i skunyams dga' ba/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba/ 'dod pa la rten pa/ de'i ngo bo 'dod pa/ 'dod pa nye bar mchod 7pa/ 'dod pa rgyun chad pa med pa gang yin pa bsdus pa de dag thams cad 'byung la/ bde ba'i gnas de na bde ba des namangon par 'dod pa/ ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba byas 69—182

shing bsags pa'i las de zad 1par ma gyur pa de srid du de na lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba de sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan zhing yul gyi bde ba dang /nyams bde ba des dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par mya ngan dang / 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang bral bar 'gyur la/ skyon med pa dang / gzugs bzang ba dang / skye bo thams cad dga' ba dang / shin tu 'byor pa 2dang ldan pa dang / dus dang 'thun pa'i gzugs bzang ba dang / tshe'i bar chad med par 'chi bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo //de nas yang dge slong de gnas bcu mthar chags su rtog par byed de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas de tsam du zad dam zhes rtog par byed dol/ /des gnas bcu las gnas gzhan bcu gcig pa med de/ lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas bcu ni de dag nyid yin par mthong ngo / /des lha lag na yol go thogs pa rnams kyi gnas bcu ma lus par brtags nas/rgyal chen bzhi'i nang na che ba gnas gsum pa rtag tu myos gnas zhes bya ba thams cad la rtog par byed de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas de dag gi gnas ji tsam zhig yod zhig gu snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na / rtag tu myos gnas de dag gi ziganas kyang bcu yod de/ 'di lta ste/ lhag par dga' ba dang / ud pa la'i mdog dang / pad ma dkar spyod dang / grong khyer dmar gnas dang / sna tshogs dang / mtho bar gnas dang / rgyan chang 69—183

myos gnas dang / yul la 'dod pa dang / chu bsil gnas dang / brtan dga' ste/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas ni bcu ponye'adi dag yin no/ /sa gzhan gang zhig tu las gang gis gang du skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ sems shin tukhudang zhing rnyingasal rtog pa med pa dang / sems bzang po yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa gang gis shing ljon pa chen po gang la yi dgas dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dag gnas pa'i shing ljon pa de/ gcod pa na yongs su skyobalgepar byed la/ yi dgas dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po de dag gnas dang bral bas 'tshe bar mi0byed / de'i mthus bde bar gnas na de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi gnas/ lhag par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de gnas gzhan de na chu bsil ba zhes bya ba'i rdzing bu yangs pa gser gyi mdog dang ldan pa/ bya ngang pa dang / kā raṇḍa ba dang / ngur pa lus gser gyi kha dogashogecan sgra 'byin pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi pad ma rab tu mang po rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /pad ma'i rdzing chu bsil ba de dag na yang kun nas gser gyi tshal zhes bya ba yod de / pad ma'i rdzing de gser dang dngul gyi shing ljon pa rnams kyis kun nas dkrigs shing bskor nas skye'o⑧/ /shing de rnams kyang pad ma'i rdzing gi7chu de'i nang na/ de rnams kyi grib ma 'bab pa'i gzugs du ma gzugs brnyan lta bur snang la/ pad ma'i rdzing de yang chu'i nang du shing ljon pa'i grib ma de rnams kyi gzugs brnyan lta bur snang ngo / /de yang pad ma dang / me tog ud pa la dang ske/ ku nyunyamu das mdzes par byas pa dag ni/ ji ltar brgya byin yang der rtse 69—184

ba'i blo skye brtso17de ltar mdzes pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe lha dang lha ma yin g.yul 'gyed par 'babs 5)pa na nyi ma shar ba'i mdog lta bu'i pad ma 'bum phrag du mas mdzes par byas pa de rnams mthong ste/ brtags nas lha rnams la smras pa/kye ma 'di ltar chu bsil ba'i rdzing bu skyon med pa 'di nyid shin tu nyams dga' ba yin no/ /de nas yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rdzing bu de rnams su yid rtag tu dga' zhing rdzing bu'i 'gram du yid rab tu mgu ba'i lha dang / lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas silas snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan zhing bde ba dpe med pa dang ldan pa ci dga' dgur byed pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/shin tu bde ba dang ldan pa/ kha zas dang / gnas dang / rang dgar za zhing 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod 4par byed do/ /de nas yang byung nas gal te gnas gzhan du 'gro bar pa'adod na/ lus dang sems gdung ba rnams dang bral ba/ sems shin tu dga' ba bde ba shin tu rgya che zhing 'dod pa dang ldan pa rnams lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dgod cing glu cadabyangs len lam / bro gar byed pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing rtag tu rtse ba na / lha'i lus dang yid la bde ba gang dang gang dag 'dod pa de dang de dag nyon mongs pa med cing shin tu rgyas pa dang / tshegs chung ngus 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lnga yul lnga dag la spyod pa yang bde ba la gnas pa des tshim mi myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srid pa me lta bu 8dag la spyod pa de yul gang gis kyang tshim par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ri dang skyed mos tshal dang / chu bo dang / gzhal med khang dang / lteng 9ka dang / chu dngo 1 rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna bdun gyis 63—185

mdzes par byas pa/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra snyan pa 'byin cing 'don ①pa rnams su lha de grogs dang lhan cig bde ba du ma latshanariganas shing bee ḍūrya'i tshal gyi grib mas mdzes par byas pa dag na bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra 'byin cing 'donasapa'i tshal dang nye ba'i tshal rnams nams)dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ mgu bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /bee ḍūrya dang / gser dang /dngul dang / byi ru'i ri rab kyi zom la rang dgar 'khod pa/ kha cig ni nyi ma ltar gzi tsherin/ kha cig ni zla ba ltar mdangs gsal/ kha cig ni gzugs dpe 6)med pa dang ldan te/ ji ltar legs par byas pa'i las de rnams kyis〈pelus mngon par bsgrubs pa de ltar lha yul du58)yang rnam par mdzes pa yin no/ /rgyu rkyen dang 'thun par spyod pa de ji po)srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong bsngo ༷byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du lha'i 'jig rten de na sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pas dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud07'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par shin tu nyams dga' ba'i yul lo legs shing bde b.rarwarnyeskye la/ shin tu 'byor pa dang ldan zhing / mchog tu bde bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des hunyethos pa las byung ba'i shes pas/lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas ud pa la mdog ces bya ba ji ltar gnas 69wa 186

pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ chos dang ldan zhing chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa gang gis 'di ltar me tog ud pa la bskyed pa 'dis sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun rnams kyi longs spyod bya'o snyam du bsams nas bskyed la1/ de yang 'bul bar byed cing de sems la dga' bar yang 'dzin na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten ud pa la namadog gi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang lha yul du rtse ba'i skye bo dang / dga' dgur spyad pa de dga' ya yar 3rtse ba dang / dga' ba dang / steg pa dang / 'jo ba dang / rol mo'i sgra dang /glu dbyangs dang / bro gar byed pa dang ni ldan/ bde ba du ma la ni gnas/tshal nas tshal dang / bee ḍūrya'i tshal gyi grib ma mdzes pa dang / gser btso ma dang ske/ byi ru lta bu'i sa gzhi bde ba mthon dman laran pa rnams su ni rgyu/ lha mo'i tshogs du mas ni yongs su bskor/ kha zas zhim po ni za/ ci dga' dgur 'dod pa thams cad bsam 5pa tsam gyis ni 'grub/ ngo bo nyid kyi ri tsidu ma la ni gnas/ bde ba las mchog tu bde ba ni thob/ dbang po lnga yul lnga la chags shing dga' ba ni nyin gcig 7bzhin nyams dga' bar byed/ ud pa la sngon po dang / bai ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu'i lus ni ud pa la'i tshal nas ud 8pa la'i tshal du rgyu/ ud pa la'i dri gang yin pa de dpag tshad brgyar ni ldang /ud pa la'i dri zhim po des lha'i me tog gi dri 9zhim po gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan 1 nas rgyal po bzhin du ni mdzes/ rgyu dang 'thun par 'brel pa'i rim gyis 11rgyu dang 'thun par 'bras bu 'byung bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 69—187

sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs te/ de mtho ris su phyin nas kyang me tog ud pa la de rnams las dga' ba rnam pa mang po du ma 'thob bo/ /de nas de ltar spyod cing bde ba la gnas pa'i dbang po drug nges par 'byung ba la dga' ba/ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de na dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang / skal btumanyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/de las de dang rgyushe'athun par me tog mang po bskyed cing 'byor pa'i yul rnams su skye bar 'gyur la/ shin tu rgya che ba dang ldan pa dang / mchog tu bde ba dang ldan pa dang / gnod pa med par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas/ lha yul na rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas/ pad ma dkar spyod ces bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas / des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing / lus ngag gi dri ma dang bral ba sems pas yongs su bsgoms pa'i snying dang ldan pa gang gis sangs rgyas sam/ chos sam/ dge 'dun la me tog dbulab ba'i don du pad ma'i tshal bskyed cing / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang ske/ dge 'dun la yang sems dad pa dang ldan par gyur na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi gnas pad ma dkar spyod kyi lha rnams kyi nang du 69—188

skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang legs par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la spyod0 de/ 'di lta ste/ rgyan dang / rin po che dang / 'od sna tshogs kyis ni lus brgyan/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis ni mchod/ lha mo'i tshogs me tog phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis ni yongs su bskor/ rdo rje dang / mthon ka dang /ma rgad dang / spug dang / 'phyang 'phrul gyi 'od kyis ni lus brgyan/ dga' ya yar rab tu dga' zhing rtse bar ni gnas/ mtho ris dang 'thun pa'i kun dga'i ra bar gnas shing bde ba rtag tu myong sten/ ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de bde ba dpe med pa rnam pa du ma yon tan shin tu che ba dang ldan pa/ skye bo thams cad dang lhan cig gzhan la gnod pa med cing kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa rnam pa sna tshogs de dang de dag myong bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhane la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi rnams kyi nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par nor gyi bdag po shin tu bde ba dang ldan zhing bu dang dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / rgyal pos kyang bkur bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi ca'abras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi 5gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas grong khyer dmar gnas zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /gnas der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes 69—189

pas brtags na/ sems pa dang ldan pa phan par 'dod pa gus pa'i snying dang ldan pa gang yin pa des/ dge slong7yang dag par rab tu byung ba'i chos gos shing byis pa la'i shun pas kha dog dmar por bsgyur tayos/ gur gum mamatsho/bcod dam/ mtshal lam/ skyu ru ra'am/ btsag gam/ bab la'am/ldong ros sam/ me tog ban du sa tshur ribadang bcas pas kha dog dmar por bsgyur na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten grong khyer dmar gnas kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang phreng ba dang gos dmar po gyon pa de'i gnas de ni 'od kyis brgyan pa'i lus kyis rtag tu gsal bar byas pa yin la/ lha de dag thams cad kyang ci dga' dgur spyod pa yin te/ de rnams kyi mthus gnas de dag thams cad rnam pa de lta bur dmar bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar pad ma rā skyonoga'i 'od de gos pa med pa ltar lha de rnams kyang de ltar dmar por snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyan gyi kha dog sngon po dang ske/ ser por 'dres shing rin po ches bklubs 57)pa gzhan gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang dmar por 'gyur te/ legs par byas pa'i las des de'i gos gsal ba rnams kyis dmar por 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe de rtse zhing gzhal med khang dang pad ma'i tshal dang / lteng ka dang / tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal sna tshogs dang / lha mo cha byad dang rgyan dmar po sna tshogs thogs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba dag yul du mar 'gro ba na/ de'i tshe de dag gi rgyan rnams kyi tshon rtsi gsal ba dang / kha dog thams cad kyang gsal bar snang ngo / /rin po che'i 'od sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i bu de tshal nas tshal dang / ri'i zom nas ri'i zom dang / pad ma'i tshal nas pad ma'i tshal dang / chu bo dang /69—190

'bab chu dang / lteng ka dang / nye ba'i tshal nas chu bo dang / 'bab chu dang /lteng ka dang / nye ba'i tshal du 'gro bar byed do/ /sil snyan yan lag 1lnga dang ldan pa'i glu dbyangs nye bar len cing phan tshun grogs su gyur pa/ so sor chags pa'i snying gis dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /sred pa'i tshogs drug gis yid rab tu dga' ba dag bdud rtsi'i zas bzang po la ni za/ myos pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i btung ba zhim po ni tshim par 'thung ste/ ji srid du tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor nas dga' ba sna tshogs byed do/ /de ltar de dag rtse ba sna tshogs dge slong des mngon par mthong nas/'di ltar tshigs su bcad de nasmras pa/ mtho bas mtho ba'i ri rab 3na/ /de bas mtho ba rtag tu dge/ /lha mchog rnams kyi 'og min 4du/ /dge bas skye bo khrid par byed/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /tshul khrims dag kyang bsrungs na ni / /dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin 'di/ /lha rnams nang du smin par 'gyur/ /tshul khrims chu ni shin tu dang / /rab tu gang bar 5kun nas su/ /khrus byas mi ni lha rnams kyi/ /bde ba'i drung du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims rtag tu dul/ /'byung po kun la phan par dga'/ /ye shes brtson la byams sems ldan/ /lha yi 'dun nesar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /nyes bcom byed dang ldan pa dang / /tshul khrims rin po che yis brgyan/ /sems can kun la brtse ldan pa / /lha yul rnams na de dag mkhas/ /drang po rnams ni gser 'dra ste/ /dri ma dang ni sdig rnams sbyangs/ /yang dag las kyi mtha' brtson pa/ /lha yul rnams na 7de dag mkhas/ /sems can kun la brtse ldan zhing / /sems can kun la phan 'dod la / /sdig kun rnam par spangs pa gang / /de dag lha yi 69wa 191

gnas na gnas/ /legs par rtog pa nyin gcig bzhin/ /tshul khrims srung bar byed pa gang / /nyin gcig bzhin du de rnams kyi/ /bde ba du ma de dag myong ske/ /skyes bu de nyid sems pa po/ /tshul khrims rta la zhon nas su/ / rtsen pa nyu)du ma ldan pa dag /lha yi gnas su 'gro bar byed/ /gang zhig lha yi gnas na rtse/ /gang zhig bde ba bla na med/ /de dag 'thun par tshul khrims kyi/ /'bras bur de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /gang zhig lha yi7phreng rgyan dang / /lha yi phreng bas bklubs50pa dang / /lha rnams mtho ris rtse ba ni/ /de kun dge ba'i rgyu las byung / /pad ma ud pal nyams dga'i tshal/ /tshal dang nags tshal brgyan pa dang / /mtho ris lha rnams dga' ba gang / /de kun dge las skyes pa'i 'bras/ /nam mkha' gzhal med khang gnas dang / /lha yi rin chen brgyan pa dang / /lha rnams dri med gsal ba gang / /de dag tshul khrims 'bras bu yin/ /gser dang me tog sna tshogs dang / /kun nas ri bo'i steng rnams su/ /lha rnams dga' byed gang yin de/ /tshul khrims las byung 'bras bu yin/ /ji ltar mi dag rang khyim du/ /zhugs nas 'jigs pa med par 'gyur / /de bzhin tshul khrims yang dag spyod/ /mi rnams lha yi byaganas su 'gro / /'di ltar lha yi nang du 'gro ba'i dri/ /bla med tshul khrims ldan pa dri zhim pa/ /me tog ke7ta ka dang ma lus56rika /tsam pa ka yi dri dang mtshungs pa min / /tshul khrims yongs su srung ba gang / /de dag 'tsho ba'i phul yin no/ /gang zhig tshul khrims yongs spong ba/ /'chi ba'i nang na mi bzadasnyi'achi/ /bdag la rtag tu byams 'dod pa'ang / /yon tan 'di dag rig nas su/ /tshul khrims legs par bsrung bya zhing / /tshul khrims 'chal pa rnam par spong / /69—192

tshul khrims srung ba rtag tu dul/ /bzod pa ldan zhing blta na sdug /them skas lta bur 'dzegs nas su/ /lha yi 'dun 1sar 'gro bar byed/ /de ltar dge slong des rang gi las la spyod pa'i lha rnams kyang mthong / las kyi 'bras bu sna tshogs kyang mthong nas 'khor ba las 'dod chags dang bral lo/ /grong khyer dmar po na gnas pa'i lha de dag kyang ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba legs par byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de na dga' bar byed/ /rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /de phyis lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis pasems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang /dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par 'jig rten pa thams cad dga' zhing nor mang po dang ldan pa dang / lho phyogs su gnod pa med par skye bar 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas sna tshogs zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na 'di ltar sems pas ridang ldan par gyur cing sems pas brlan pa'i snying dang ldan pa gang gis sems can tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams la bza' ba dang / btung ba dang ske/ bza' bca' dang / tshod ma sna tshogs dag byin na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs kyi lha rnams kyi nang ladu skye bar 69—193

'gyur ro/ /las sna tshogs kyis bskyed pa/ bde ba sna tshogs la ni spyod/g.yog pa dang mal stan sna tshogs kyi nang na ni 'gre17/ bde bar gnas pa'i kun dga' ra ba dang 5/ rtse ba dang / 'gros sna tshogs ni ri byed/ tshal dang skyed mos tshal sna tshogs su ni 'gro/ lha mo'i tshogs cha byad sna tshogs thogs pa ni phyi bzhin 'brang / tshal dang / nags 47tshal dang / ri bo sna tshogs dang /chu bo dang / pad ma'i tshal dang / ud pa la dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i skyed mos tshal sna tshogs dag na ni gnas/ bgo ba dang / mal cha dang /sgeg 5pa'i tshal sna tshogs na ni spyod/ ga zha'i 4)gtam brjod cing 'du 'dzi la dga' la/ shin tu chags pa'i sems sna tshogs kyis ni 'tsho/ rtog pas bskyed pa la dga' 7zhing / blo rnam par chags pa rab tu myos pa yin te/ de ltar sretrelas sna tshogs byas nas rgyu sna tshogs byed pa de tshal sna tshogs rnams su bde ba sna tshogs dag myong bar byed do/ /de nas dge slong de shin tu dga' nas 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ri mo mkhan gyi ri mo rnams/ /de ni sna tshogs 'dri ma yin/ /gang zhig las kyi ri mo mkhan/ /mtho ris su ni mang du 'dri/ /tshon 'ortsis bris pa bris mi 'gyur/ /de ni bgrang bar grangs yod kyi/ /las kyis bris pa grangs med de/ /de ni sems kyis 'dri bar byed/ /rtsig 3 snapa zhig na nges par yang / /ri mo ma lus 'jig 11par 'gyur/ /las kyis bris pa lus zhig kyang glu/ /'jig pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar ri mo mkhan gcig cig /ri mo sna tshogs 'dri ba dag /de bzhin sems ni gcig pu yis/ /las rnams sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /ji ltar tshon rtsi gsal ba lngas/ /bris pa snang la stod par byed/ /de ltar dbang po lnga rnams kyi/ /las kyis 'khor bar 'khor bar 69—194

'dri / /ri mo mkhan gyi mi dag ni/ /du ma dag tu snang 'gyur gyi/ /ri mo mkhan de sems phra bas/ /thams cad du ni mi mthong ngo / /ri mo legs shing legs pa dag /ji ltar rtsig 1ngos rnams la 'dri/ /las rnams legs shing legs pa dag /de ltar sems la 'dri bar byed/ /ji ltar nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /sems rgyun 'byung la sems gnas 'gyur/ /de ltar nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /de bzhin las kyi rjes su 'jug /ji ltar rlung dang dud pa rdul / /gdung ba rnams kyis ri mo 'jig /de ltar dge dang mi dge ba/ /spangs na las kyi ri mo 'jig /de ltar 2rinodage slong des sems ri mo mkhan lta bu la rag las pa mngon parasamathong nas/ las kyi de nyid rnam par mthong ba 'khor ba las yid byung ngo / /lha sna tshogs de dag gi las sna tshogs de dag kyang ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba'i las byas shing bsags pa bde 'gro nges par myong bar 'gyur ba de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du myong bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i nang du ma skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba (4)mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par rtag tu rgyu zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul che ba dang / nor dang ldan pa dang / dpon sna byed pas 'tsho bar 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par 5ge)smin pasashes pa de/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ lha rtag tu myos gnas rnams kyi gnas mtho bar gnas zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems 69—195

can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ legs par spyad pa'i las mngon par shes pas/ sems pas yongs su bsgoms pa'i sems dang ldan pa gang gis sems can rnams skye grang ba dang tsha ba yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir bsod nams kyi gnas mal byas na/de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten mtho bar gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang reg pa las bde bar gnas pa de dbang po lnga'i yul gyi bde ba rnam pa du ma rnam pa mang po dag myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i ris de na tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dag yod de/ 'di lta ste/me tog man 'o0)ra ba la rtse ba dang / stugatsopo sbyor gnas dang / ngal bsos bder nodang / rtse dang sgra 'byin ldan dang / sgyu ma kun dga' dang 'jigs med de / tshal dang nye ba'i tshal de dag tu lha de lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa dag dga' bar byed/ dgod par byed/ rtse bar byed/ sgeg par byed do/ /sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pas dga' bar byed cing blo rang dgar gnas pa bdag nyid chen po ci dgar sgrogs pa/ bde ba mchog dang ldan pa skyid55)par gnas pa rnams pad ma'i tshal nasal)pad ma'i tshal du 'dong bar byed de9)/ mtho ris dang 'thun pa'i rin po che'i snying po rab tu mang pos rnam par brgyan pa/ rtag tu bag tsha ba med par spyod pa rnams yul mtho ba nas yul mtho ba dang ⑧/ gser gyi ri rab 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od rnams kyis gsal bar byas pa de dag la lus nad med pa rnams yongs su rgyu bar:da cing rtag tu bde bas myos par gnas pa/ legs57par byas pa mang po 'dod par byas pa'i las kyis der skyes pa rnams dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur 69—196
