gser dang / bee ḍūrya'i pad ma'i 'dam bu'i 17nang na bal glang mo dang lhan cig rtse zhing yul der 'gro bar byed do/ /lha'i rgyal po brgya byin lha'i natshogs dang ske/ lha mo'i tshogs sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba ltar/ glang po che'i rgyal po de yang de lta bu yin la/ pad ma gser btso ma lta bu dang / nam mkha' la nyi ma 'bum phrag 'char 5)ba/ de lta bu'i 'od bzang po 'char ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa der de dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed/ rtsed mo byed/ dud 'gror gyur kyang lha'i bde ba myong ba yin no/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po brgya byin der song nas/ lag pa gnyis kyis byugs shing phyi pa bdar byed la/ kye bdag gi glang po che'i rgyal po 'di ni g.yul 'gyed pa la dgos pa yin te/ lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa'i tshe/ 'di'i steng nas bdag rgyal ba thob bo/ /de nas glang po che mchog phyi 6bdar byas nas/ skyed mos tshal thams cad 'byor ldan na khang bzangs mya ngan bral zhes bya ba ga la ba der 'gro bar byed de/ chu'i zam pa lta bu'i skas de las 'dzegs nas/ der lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te 'jug par byed do/ /der zhugs nas lha'i rgyal po de lha mo bye ba phrag dgu'i mdun na rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed do/ /lha'i rgyal po de rnams dang lhan cig lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams 'byor cing ldan par gyur pas 7rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed do/ /lha'i rgyal po rang gi las dang 'thun par longs spyod 'byor te/ lha de dag dang lha'i rgyal po de ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa dang / so so yang dag par myong bar 'gyur ba bde ba'i rnam par smin pa/ bde ba so sor yang dag par myong bar 'gyur ba'i las 69wa 294

zad par ma gyur pa de srid du 'di ltar/ skyed mos tshal brgya snyed kyis brgyan pa'i lha'i 'dun 1sa chos bzang gi skyed mos tshal de na bde ba kun dang ldan zhing /lha'i tshogs thams cad dang bcas pas yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i rol mo rnams kyis rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed do/ /de dag phyis lha'i 'dunamanas chos bzang danas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang caji ltar las de dang nye bar 'gro zhing ske/ myong bar 'gyur ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / yi 5)dgas dang /dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na/ de las de dang rgyu 'thun par mchog tu bde ba dang ske/ rig nepa'i blo 7dri ma med pa dang / phan natshun gyi gtso bo'am/ grong gi gtso bo'am/ yul gyi gtso bo'am/ grong khyer gyi gtso bo'am/ phan tshun gyi gnyen 'dab 9dang / rtsa lag dang / bde bar lhan cig 'khod par 'gyur ro//lha'i rgyal po de ni ngan song gi sgo bcad pa yin te/ lha de dag gi 'chi 'pho ba la mngon par brtags sanas 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa gang yin pa de dag gi/ /tshal ni pad ma sna tshogs dang / /rtse mo mchog ste nyams dga' dang ske/ /rin po che dang ldan pa dang / /mtsho dang 'bab chu rin po che'i/ /rdo ba sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /ljon shing me tog sna tshogs dang / /bya ni sna tshogs dag gis khebs/ /gser las byas pa'i 17dpag bsam 32shing / /kha cig dri med bee ḍūrya/ /dngul dang gser ni btso ma yin/ /tshal ni rnam par 'dres pa bskyed/ /bung ba rnams ni sgra 'byin pas/ /pad ma'i rdzing ni rnam par mdzes/ /khang bzangs mchog ni nyams dga' zhing / /rin po che ni che dang ldan/ /rnam par brgyan pa nyams dga' ste/ /lha la 'os pa thams cad 69wa 295

yod / /de dag thams cad de bzhin 'juganyu7 /skye bo rnams ni yongs su 'gyur//kye ma sred pas bslus pa yi/ /lha rnams kun gyi bde ba ni/ /sgyu ma chu bur dbu nab dang / /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu yin/ /sred dpa dug dang me 'dra ba/ /'jig rten 'jig pa'i phyir gnas te/ /sred pa'i mtshor ni 'khyam byed cing / /skye bo de kun 'jig par byed/ /'dod pa longs pasam )chog mi shes/ /bde ba 'dod pas chog mi shes/ /'chi ba'i me yis rnam bsregs pa/ /lha tshogs de dag ga las 5'ongs/ /sred ne'adis 'jig rten gzengs 7)pa rnams/ /ye nas ngan te 'phags pa min/ /gang gis rnam par rmongs pa'i lha/ /'chi ba yi ni dbang du song / /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin/ /gnod sbyin sems can dmyal ba klu / /'chi ba'i zhags pa mi bzad pasan/ /thams cad dbang med 'gro bar 'gyur / /khams gsum pa ste 'di dag kun/ /'chi ba'i zhags pas sbrel gyur kyang ske/ /sred pa'i rmongs pas rmongs pa rnams/ /dbang med mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar brgya byin gyis rtag tu lha de rnams kyi skye ba dang / gzhan mi rtag pa 'chi ba dag mthong nas/ lha dag shin tu go bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'byung po kun la phan bzhed pa/ /bcom ldan de 9la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis khosred pa dug 'dra 'di/ /'jig rten pa la mang du gsungs / /mdor na shes dang shes bya dag /de yis 'di kun thugs su chud/ /shes dang shes bya ma gtogs par/ /gsum pa 11dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni mi rtag sdug bsngal stong / /byed pa po yang spangs pa yin/ /de nyid lam ni rnam ston pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni 'khor bar 12gsungs/ /de ltar dbang po de 15phyag rgya 'dis btab pa'i yid dri ma med pas bcom ldan 'das la 69wa 296

bstod do/ /bstod nas de nas yang lha'i bde ba yang nyams su myong bar byed de/de ltar de lha'i bde ba thams cad myong ba yin no/ /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa des sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas mtho ba na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /sems can dag las gang gis der skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na 'di ltar gang gzhan gyis gsod pa po dag nyi ma gcig tsam du srog gcod pa spong ba'i tshul khrims srung du bcug 1la / 'khor ba las thar napa 'dod pa rnams ma byin par len pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs nas 'bras bu chung ngur 'gyur ba yang spong du 'jug na/de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang na mtho ba'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnas mtho ba de yang ri rab kyi steng na mtho ba yin la/ khyed cag gi las sna tshogs snang ba bzhin gser dang dngul gyi bkra bas phye ba yin no/ /lha rnams mtho ba'i gnas der 'dzegs nas/ ri rab kyi drung mthams cad lta bar byed de/ gser dang dngul las byas shing / bai ḍūrya bkra bas rnam par phye ba rnam pa du ma la lta bar byed do/ /lha'i phreng ba dang gos gyon pa rnams gser gyis brgyan pa'i sa gzhi 4rnams la dga' bar byed/yongs su spyod par byed la/ lha mo'i tshogs sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing sdug pa dang / lhan cig bai ḍūrya'i tshal dang nye ba'i tshal rnams su dga' bar byed / yongs su spyod par byed do/ /der de dag gi rtag tu bza' ba dang /btung ba chu bo ltar 'bab ste/ 'di lta ste/ chu bo ro zhim 5zhes bya ba dang /69wa 297

chu bo shugs chen 1'bab ces bya ba dang / chu bo dga' bcas zhes bya ba dang /chu bo dga' bcas che 5zhes bya ba dang / chu bo brtsegs 'bab ces bya ba dang /chu bo shugs phreng zhes bya ba dang / chu bo stong 'bab ces bya ba dang / chu bo gar dgar 'bab ces bya ba ste/ chu bo de dag ni myos pa'i skyon dang bral zhing /btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad rab tu 'bab pa yin no/ /ro sna tshogs dang mdog sna tshogs yod pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ 'o ma'i mdog dang / pad ma rā ga'i mdog dang / an da rnyil gyi mdog dang 'thun pa dang / bee ḍūrya'i mdog dang / gser gyi mdog ltar ser ba dang / kha cig mdog 'dres pa dang / chu shin tu dri zhim zhing brtan pa dag tu khyad par 'phags pa yang 'bab bo/ /gzhan yang bza' ba ro dang / dri dang mdog sna tshogs su 'byung ste / 'di lta ste/ ro sha kha ra 'dra ba dang / lha'i dri dang / mdog dang mdog skya bo dang / ro ji ltar 'dod pa 5dag ste/ lha rnams ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin du bza' ba rnams kyi ro de dag kyang de ltar 'gyur ro/ /tshal dang nags tshal sna tshogs dag me tog dri zhim po rnams kyis nye bar mdzes par byas shing ske/ bya kha dog sna tshogs dang / rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin te/ de dag sa'i phyogs nyams dga' ba der lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas sil snyan dang / glu 6dbyangs dang / bro gar sna tshogs kyis rtse 7bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed do/ /der tshal 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/8 shing sā 9la'i tshal dang ske/ shing sā khol chen po'i tshal dang / ji ltar 'dod pa'i shing ljon pa'i tshal dang / me tog rtag tu yod pa'i tshal dang / rlung ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 69wa 298

bde bar 'bab pa'i tshal te/ tshal dga' ba de rnams na gser gyi lcug ma 'phyangs pas 1ni mdzes/ dril bu g.yer ku'i dra bas ni dkrigs/ bya 'bum snyed sgra 'byin pa dga' ba lha'i dbang po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i bde ba dag gis lha rnams nye bar 'tsho bar byed do/ /phan tshun grogs su gyur cing phan tshun longs spyod 2pa gcig dpu don du byed pa/ nad dang mya ngan dang bral ba/bkres pa dang skom pa dang bral ba/ lus ngal ba cadang bral ba/ tshol ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ ci dgar spyod pa la brtson pa/ ci dgar rgyu ba/ci dgar gnas pa dag tshal gyi nang dang / skyed mos tshal dang / pad ma'i tshal dang / mthong na yid 'phrog rnams su dga' bar byed do/ /mtho ba na gnas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas tshim pa'i lha rnams 'od ni rang gi 'od la lus ni ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ phra ba dang / sgom pa dang / yang bar sgyur rab/ci dgar 'gro ba/ gar dgar 'gro ba/ rang dgar 'gro ba/ gang thob par 'dod pa de thob par 'gyur zhing / thob nas sus kyang mi 'phrogs la 6thob nas de'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mtho ba'i gnas na 7gnas par gyur pa'i lha de rnams la bde ba'i rnam pa gzhan yang yod de/ rang gis legs par byas pa'i las rgyu dang 'bras bus kun nas bslang bas/ ji srid du 'dod cing sdug la yid du 'ong ba legs par bsrungs pa'i tshul khrims srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa spangs pa zad par ma gyur pa de srid du lha mo'i tshogs rnams dang dga' bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /der las zad nas lha'i ris de 8nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas las kyis 9'gro ba ji lta ba dang las la rton 1 pa dang / 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin skye bar 'gyur te/ sems can 69wa 299

dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang na skye bar 'gyur ro//gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes 1rin/ de na/las des kyidang rgyu 'thun par ri la gnas pa rtag tu bde bar 'gyur zhing / nor dang shin tu ldan pa dang / rab tu bde ba dang / mchog tu gzugs bzang ba dang /'jig rten gyi bar bzang por dro ba dang / bsil ba'i nye ba'i 4tshal rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de'i/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha rnams kyi gnas ri rtse na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/gang gis lus kyi tshul khrims rnam ne gnyis bsrungs pa yin te/ srog chags gsad par chad pa dang / bcings pa thar bar byas shing / mthu rab tu che bar gyur la nus par ldan pa zhig lam du zhugs te/ bkres shing skom bzhin du bu ram shing ngam/ ldum ra'am/ rdzi'u'i 7 grong dag tu ba'i bcud dam/ bu ram shing gi bcud ma byin par ma /blangs9/ sems can gsad par bya ba dang 0/ ma byin par blangs nas 'jigs te 'gro ba thar bar byas pa'i skyes bu dam pa de lus dang bral nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas/ ri rtser gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de bde ba'i longs spyod du ma dang ldan zhing / de yul chu bo lta bu du mas bdas pa yin la/ de yang 'dod chags chu bo lta bu yin/ 'di lta ste / 'dod chags kyi chu bo dang / rgyags pa'i glong dang / mgu ba'i gling du 69wa 300

chags pa dang / kun dga'i chu mig dang / kun du rtog pa'i rlabs 1dang /gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya sdug pa'i bya dang /lta ba chu srin 'dzin khri kun du 'khrugs pa dang / rab tu thogs pa du ma ya yor 'gro ba dang / tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal chu yis bar bur ded pa dang / phra nadog gi nya dang / spro ba chu las brgal ba dang / yul du ma'i ri khrod nas chu 'bab ste/ sred dpa'i chu bo 'dam rdzab la sogs pa rnam pa de lta bu dag las lha rnams 'byung bar mi nus so/ /gzhan yang chu bo gang gā'i pha rol gyi 'gram gyi rlabs mi mngon pa 5ltar/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas rgyun du shin tu zab mor rab tu zhugs pa/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams na skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang /6) mya ngan dang ske/ smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang /'khrug pa rlabs lta bus khyab cing / myur du 'gro ba'i sred pa chu klung lta bu de sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu yang yin la/ mi rnams kyis kyang chog par 7'dzin mi nus te/ de ltar sred pa'i rnam pa chu bo lta bus ri rtse na gnas pa'i lha rnams rab tu bdas /so/ /der 9lha de dag lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te/lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams 'byor cing ldan par gyur pas dga' bar byed / rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /der tshal 'di 1 lta bu 1 dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ tshal rtag tu rab dga' zhes bya ba dang ske/ tshal rtag tu mngon dga' zhes bya ba dang / tshal sprin ltar dkar brtsegs zhes bya ba dang / tshal kun nas mngon dga' zhes bya ba dang / tshal zla ba 'dra zhes bya ba dang / tshal gang gā'i 2steng du rgyu zhes bya ba ste/ tshal 'di 69wa 301

dag ni ri rtse na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi yin no/ /tshal de rnams kyi nang du lha dag bde ba du ma dang ldan zhing / bud med kyi dga' ba rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /btung ba'i chu bo rnams kyang 'di lta ste/ chu bo sna tshogs zhes bya ba dang / chu bo lag 1mthil gyis byug cing reg pa zhes bya ba dang / chu bo ngoms mi myong zhes bya ba dang / chu bo me tog ku mu da dang / ud pa la skye zhes bya ba ste/ chu bo de nadag gi 'gram gnyi ga ril khebs pa yin no/ /dngul dang / shel dang / gser gyi shing ljon pa 'bras bu dang ldan zhing / me tog dang ldan pa rnams kyis lha'i sa gzhi chode dag nyams dga' bar brgyan pa'i sa gzhi 5der dge ba'i las sna tshogs dang / las 6byas pa sna tshogs kun nas bslang ba rnams kyis tshal de dag dang / chu bo de dag dang ske/ sa gzhi 7nide dag dang / zas dang skom chu bo ltar 'bab pa de dag tu/lha nade rnams lha'i rol mo dang / lha'i gnas 9chen po dang / thags su btags pa ma yin pa'i lha'i gos rnams kyis dga' bar byed do/ /lha de rnams rang las 'od 'byung la/ sha dang / rus pa dang / rnag khrag dang bral ba/lus dang / ngag dang / yid ngal ba dang bral ba/ lus dang yid rtag tu kun nas dga' ba rnams ji srid du lus dang ngag gi 'dod pa 1 sdug pa yid du 'ong ba shin tu bsil ba/ rnam par smin pa mchog tu bde ba/ mtho ris su skye ba nges par myong bar 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i las ma zad pa de srid du 'gros 'chos shing dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed do/ /de dag las zad de lha'i 'jig rten de nas 'chi bar 'gyur la shi nas kyang las ji ltar byas pa bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams 69wa 302

kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba mir 'grub pa'i las kyis mi rnams kyi 1nang du skyes na/ de 2las de dang rgyu 'thun par de rtag tu longs spyod can du 'gyur zhing rtag tu shes pa la dga' ba/yid la dgod 5pa dang / rtsed mo dang / rtse ba dang / yul bzang por skye bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/sum cu rtsa gsum na lha rnams kyi gnas gzhan gang zhig yod snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ blta na sdug pa gnas pa zhes bya ba'i gnas ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur cisnyam nas/ des brtags na gang tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am/sems can gzhan chus khyer ba'am/ mtshon gyis gsad 5par bya ba srog phyung zhing ske/ nor rdzas sam/ bdag nyid la mi lta bar chu nas phyung ba dang /bkres bzhin du lam du 'gro ba na gzhan gyis ma byin par blang ba la rab tu spro ba bskyed kyang len par mi byed/ gzhan yang phyogs dben par phyin la 'tsho ba nyam nga bar 'gyur kyang 'bras bu dang rtsa ba dag ma byin par len par mi byed cing —/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa ma gus par bslab pa'i gzhi rdul phra mo tsam ral ba la yang 'jigs par lta na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro grong khyer chen po blta nan sdug tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer de yang dpag tshad khri yod la / khyams khris legs par rnam par phye ba yin no/ /grong khyer de'i sa gzhi 'dzam bu chu bo'i 9gser las byas la/ kun nas khang pa chen po bee ḍūrya las byas pa dang / gzhan yang dngul las byas pa dang / gzhan yang 'dzam bu chu 69wa 303

bo'i gser las byas pa dang / mthon ka sna tshogs las byas pa dang / gzhan yang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i khri dag gis bkra bar phye ba yin no/ /de dag gi sung yang kun nas shin tu rnam par phye ba yin la/ bzhi mdo dang / ba gam dang / sgo dang / pu shu'i rtse mo dang / khang bzangs kyi 1)ris shin tu rnam par phye ba yin no/ /khang pa de dag kyang nyi ma gang med kyang sgron ma lta bur 'gyur te/ ji ltar nyi ma med na sgron ma gsal bar byed pa de ltar nyi ma med kyang khang pa'i mchog de rnams las de ltar 'od 'byung ngo / /grong khyer de dag kun nas tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal de rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin te/tshal dang nye ba'i tshal kha cig bee ḍūrya las byas pa dag la mu tig gi dra bas bres/kha cig gser gyi shing ljon pa dag la dngul gyi dra bas bres/ kha cig dngul gyi shing ljon pa dag la gser gyi dril bu g.yer ku'i sgra 'byin/ kha cig ni rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa'i skyed mos tshal bkra ba yin la/ kha cig dpag bsam gyi 2shing yin te/ lha gang dag gi yid la bsams pa de tshal de dag las thob par 'gyur ro/ /tshal kha cig an da rnyil dang / bee ḍūrya las byas pa yin te/de na gser gyi bya rnams sgra snyan pa sna tshogs 'byin la/ gser gyi tshal gang yin pa de na dngul gyi bya rnams skad snyan pa 'byin cing rtse/ mthon ku'i tshal gang yin pa de na bya pad ma rā ga'i mdog tu 'dug pa rnams skad snyan pa 'byin cing rtse/ gser gyi tshal gang yin pa de na bya lus sna tshogs 'dres pa rnams skad snyan pa 'byin cing rtse ste/ de ltar grong khyer chen po 5legs par mthong na nye ba'i tshal du gyur pa rnams mdzes pa yin no/ /srang dang gser gyi khang pa mdzes par byas pa gang yin pa de dag la dngul gyi ka ba dang / bee ḍūrya'i shing ljon pa 69wa 304

rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin/ gser gyi srang gang yin pa de dag la bee ḍūrya'i ka ba btsugs shing gser gyi shing ljon pa dang khang pas brgyan/ srang dang ske/ khyim 'dres pas mdzes par byas pa gang yin pa de na bya gser gyi mdog can yod de/ grong khyer blta 1na sdug gang dang gang du snang ba/ de dang de dpe med par mthong ngo / /grong khyer de yang kun nas tshal chen po bzhi rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ dra ba'i phreng ba dang / shing chen po dang / 'od gsal ba dang / mthong na dga' bas so/ /tshal thams cad dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu yod de/ tshal de thams cad na chu bo chen po khri yod pa gser gyi pad mas khebs pa yin no/ /chu bo de dag shin tu nyams dga' ba yin zhing 'gram gnyi ga nazhig pa med la/ de dag gser dang / dngul dang ske/ shel dang / an da rnyil dang / shing ljon pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /tshal chen po de dag bung ba 'dab ma bee ḍūrya la lus dngul du 'dug pa'i tshogs rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin te/ gang bung ba rnams kyi sgra snyan pa'i drung na mi'i gling bu'i sgras bcu drug gi char yang mi phod do/ /bee ḍūrya'i shing ljon pa rnams la 'bras bu gser gyi mdog can shin tu dri zhim zhing khar snyi ba bas ches lhag pa'i ro dag yod la/ 'bras bu rnams kyi dri gang yin pa dpag tshad du 'byung ngo / /bya rnams ngo bo nyid kyis rgyags pa yin la/ de nas yang cadri gang yin pa des brgya 'gyur 5du shin tu rgyags par 'gyur ro/ /gser gyi shing ljon pa gang yin pa de rnams la dngul gyi 'bras bu lha'i dri dang /mdog dang / ro lnga dang ldan pa dag 'byung / shing ljon pa bai ḍūrya'i sdong po dang gser gyi 'dab ma yod pa gang yin pa de rnams la 'bras bu kha dog sna 69wa 305

tshogs yod pa dag 'byung ste/ de ltar tshal kha dog rnam pa du ma/ rnam pa sna tshogs dpe med pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bas/ grong khyer chen po blta 1na sdug yongs su bskor nas rnam par gnas so/ /kun du rtog pa'i ri mo bris pa ltar lha'i las rnam pa du ma byas shing las rnam pa du ma sna tshogs byas pa rnams kyis de rnams kyang sna tshogs su byung ba yin te/ de ltar 'bras bu rgyu dang 'thun par rgyu'i 'bras bu yin no/ /ji ltar sa bon gyi rnam pa ji srid yod pa de srid du 'bras bu'i rnam pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar grong khyer blta nan sdug na gnas pa'i lha rnams bde ba mang po du ma dag gis phrogs pa yin no/ /grong khyer de ngo bo nyid kyis legs mthong nyid yin te/ tshal khang bzangs gser dang ske/ byi ru dang / spug dag gis brgyan cing mdzes par byas pa/ dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba sna tshogs kyis dkrigs pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer ka lasgra snyan pa 'byin pas mdzes par byas pa/ tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dang / skyed mos tshal de dag tu blta 5na sdug na gnas pa'i lha rnams 'khod do/ /lha'i grong khyer na gnas rgyan dang / rol mo dang / sil snyan rtag tu sgra 'byin pa rab tu 'byin cing / lha dang lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis kun du gang ba de na btung ba dang phreng ba dag gis mdzes par byas pa / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bye ba 'bum phrag du ma dag rlung gis rab tu bskyod do/ /yang ri rab kyi steng gi grong khyer du lha'i tshogs bye ba phrag brgya stong du ma dag gis kun du gang zhing las chen po rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa de na/ 'di ltar lha mthu rab tu che ba mchod par 'os pa chen po/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ skyed mos tshal gyi dga' spyod la rtag tu yid mi dga' ba/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs 'bum phrag du mas kun du gang ba sa ya 69wa 306

phrag 'bum 'khod pa rnams brgya byin gyis ma lus par yongs su shes so/ /gang gi tshe lha de rnams gal te lha'i grong khyer chen po skyed mos tshal gyi dga' spyod de nas skyed mos tshal du dga' spyod byed du 'gro ba de'i tshe lha rnams shing rta 'bum phrag du ma rnams dang 'gro ste/ lha de rnams 'gro ba na rgyal mtshan dang / ru mtshon sdug gu rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i shing rta rnam pa sna tshogs dang ske/ kha dog sdug gu rnam pa sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs su 'dug pa bye ba phrag stong dkrigs pa dag byung ngo / /'di lta ste/ an da rnyil las byas pa'i gzhal med khang gang yin pa de la shing rta'i mda' 91pad ma rā ga lasatshan byas shing ske/ de la shing rta'i steng gi khang pa rin po che las byas/ nangs5)ni spug las byas / phyi rol ni bai ḍūrya las byas/ sa ris ni gser las byas la/ kun nas dril bu g.yer kusdoge'akhrigs pa'i sgra 'byin pa yin no/ /de nas yang lha rnams gzhal med khang rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan gyis 'gro bar byed de/ 'di lta ste/shing rta'i mda' ni gser las byas/ shing rta'i steng gi khang pa 5ni bee ḍūrya las byas / sa ris ni spug las byas/ mu tig gi dra bas ni g.yogs/ phyi rol ni rin po che ma rgad lta bu las byas/ ngos ni byi ru las byas/ srog shing ni dngul las byas pa yin no/ /kha cig shing rta'i mchog rnam pa gzhan gyis 'gro bar byed de / 'di lta ste/ kun nas shing rta'i mda' ni gser las byas/ ngos ni mu tig gis g.yogs/ sa ris ni pad ma rā tsigs shin tu rnam par phye/ srog shing ni dngul las byas/ kun nas byi rus ni mdzes par byas pa yin te/ shing rta 'bum phrag mang po thogasal ba mtshan nyid dpe med pa de dag lha'i tshogs rnams kyis kun nas yongs su bskor te/ 'bum phrag rnam pa du ma de rnams la lha dag 69—307

nyid zhon nas tshal chen po de rnams ga la ba der 'dong bar byed de/ rgyal mtshan la la bai ḍūrya las byas/ rgyal 1mtshan la la gser las byas/ yu ba la la dngul las byas/ rgyal mtshan la la'i yu ba pad ma rā ga las byas/ rgyal mtshan dang ru mtshon la la'i mdog du ma yod pa dag gis nam mkha' bar med par byas nas/ skyed mos tshal du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ yid rab tu dga' bas tshal chen po bzhi po ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /de ltar lha de rnams 'dong ba na sil snyan bye ba 'bum phrag du ma sgra 'byin cing / rol mo'i sgraganasnyan pa sna tshogs phan tshun rdob par zhugs pa dag yod de/ shin tu bzang zhing nyams dga' ba'i khyad par che ba yin no/ /ji ltar las byas pa ngan pa dang /'bring dang / chen po byas pa bzhin las bde ba rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa na 'dong bar byed de/ lha de rnams so so la lha mo'i tshogs brgya'am/ stong ngam/'bum rnams gar byed/ glu len/ rab tu dgod 4cing yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i rol mo snyan pa dang bcas pa rdob pa zhes bya ba kun du gang zhing byed la tshal chen po zhes bya ba ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa'i lha mo de dag thams cad lha de rnams dang so sor 5phrad nas de ltar bro gar byed/ dgod 6par byed/ rtsed mo byed do/ /'di ltar lha de rnams 'dod pa la rnam par zhen pa zhes bya bas 7dga' bar byed de / lha'i sgra snyan pa tshang tshing gi nang na lha'i sgra nasnyan pa de dang / gar dga' dgur 'gro ba'i lha de rnams lha'i 'dod pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de nyid kyis der skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar byed de/ la la nam mkha' la sprin nag po 'gro ba lta bu bee ḍūrya'i mdog can de rnams 'gro bar byed/ lha'i mchog de dag kha cig ni 69wa 308

'di ltar rgyan sna tshogs dang / gos sna tshogs dang / cha byad sna tshogs dang /dga' ba'i gtam sna tshogs kyis dga' gtam smra zhing nam mkha' khyab par byas nas tshal chen po ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /lha'i mchog gzhan kha cig ni gser gyi sa gzhi'i lam nas rab tu 'gro la/ 'gro ba de rnams kyi shing rta 'bum phrag du ma'i mu khyud kyis gser gyi rdul bslang ste nam mkha' 1khyab par byas nas 'dug go/ /gang gis nam mkha' de skya bor byed kyang 2/ lha rnams la 'go rabar mi byed la/ lha gang 'chi ba dang nye bar 'gyur ba de rnams kyi gdong ngam/gos de la ni 'gor nobar byed do/ /lha gang gzhan dag gis rdul de rimathong zhing 'chi ba'i ltas mthong la/ de 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med par 'gyur ba mngon par mthong nas/ de snying rje rje lta bur gyur pa'i sems kyis 'di ltar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bud shing lta bu'i yul 'byung dang / /mes bsregs lta bu'i 'chi 'gyur ba/ /lam 'di nas ni lha rnams dag /brgya'am yang na stong du 'dir/ /'chi ba gzhan gyis mthong 'gyur la/ /bdag nyid kyis ni mi mthong ste/ /phyi nas nyon mongs phrad pa dang / /bdag nyid kyis ni sdug bsngal rig /bag med pa dang 'dres pa'i sems/ /yul la rtag tu mngon par dga'/ /lus can lhan cig skyes gnas pa/ /'chi ba brtan pa mi rig go6)ske/ /bag med pa la mngon dga' zhing / /bde ba nyams dga' byed pa na/ /'chi bdag sde yis 'di drangs pa/ /rab tu 'joms te 7dug dang 'dra/ /'chi ba'i zhags pas bzung ba yi/ /khyod la skyob pa byed med de/ /sman dang sngags dang las mi skyob/ /de bzhin lha min lha mi naskyob/ /rdul rnams kyis ni gdong g.yogs pa/ /bdag nyid kyis ni mi rig ste/ /'di ni 'chi ba'i pho nya 69wa 309

yin / /shi ba phyi nas thob par 'ong / /gang zhig bde ba'i don ma mthong / /skye ba rtag tu brkam chags shing / /sred pas ngoms ni mi myong ba/ /glo bur du ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'chi bas btang ba chen po 'di/ /khyod kyi pho nya dang po ste / /'di yi 'og tu 'chi 1ba yang / /shin tu mi bzad na'abyung bar 'gyur/ /tshal dang nye ba'i tshal brgyan pa/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu spyad/ /sems can ri bo mchog de nas/ /dbang med bcings te khrid par 'gyur/ /myos pas rtse bar gnas pa dag /bde bas ngoms ni mi myong zhing / /rmongs pa sred pas ma ngoms pa/ /dbang med sa steng ltung bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar rtag tu me dag las / /du ba sngar ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ltar 'chi ba'i rtags byung ste/ /phyi nas 'chi ba gnas par 'gyur/ /de ltar lha de dag bag med pa chung ba la gnas shing ske/ sems sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba spyad pa la goms pa yin la/ lha cade'i bar chad de mthong nas bdag nyid dang lha de rjes su ston par byed do/ /de ltar lha de'i gtam smra ba na/ shing rta la zhon pa/ shing rta sna tshogs la zhon zhing /shing rta'i dril bu g.yer ma'i 5dra bas dkrigs pa/ lus cha byad du mas 'bar ba / mig rgyas pa lta bur 'dug pa/ lha'i phreng ba dang gos gyon pa/ gser btso mas rnam par brgyan pa/ gang ri rab kyi ri'i rtse mo stong snyed du phye mar rlog 6cing 'ong ngo / /de nas lha de lha'i tshogs de rnams rtog cing 'ong ba na / de bzhin du la la ni nam mkha' la/ la la ni sa la / la la ni bya'i shing rta rnams kyis / la la ni lha mo dang lhan cig glu len/ bro rdung zhing 'ong ste/ tshal dang nye ba'i tshal de dag lha'i pad ma dang / shing ljon pa dang / chu bo dang / bya dang ske/ 'bras bu dang / me tog dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / kun 69wa 310

nas mchog tu nyams dga' ba'i tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal gyi phyogs ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do1/ /blta 2na sdug na gnas pa'i lha de rnams shing rta'i mchog de dag la zhon nas/ gser gyi shing ljon pa nyi ma lta bu yod pa ga la ba der dong ngo ske/ /gang gzhan bar snang la rgyu ba de dag kyang bar snang de las babs nas skyed mos tshal ga la ba der dong 4ngo / /de ltar lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad 'dus zinas sil snyan gyi sgra dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dga' bar byed / yongs su spyod par byed de/ phan tshun grogs su gyur cing phan tshun 'gyed pa dang / phrag dog la skyo ba med pa rnams bro gar byed/ dgod 7par byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa la 'di lta ste/ rgyud nadang / rnga dang / sil dgrol dang/ gling bu'i sgra dang ske/ glu ste rnam pa 'di lngas kha zas 9chu bo ltar 'bab pa dang / btung ba chu bo ltar 'bab pa'i ngogs su lha dang lha mo'i tshogs de dag phan tshun dga' zhing lhan cig tu skyed mos tshal der rtses 1 nas/ gang na bai ḍūrya dang gser gyi 'bras bu yod pa/ 'bras bu mdog dang dri zhim pa ro mngar ba/ sbrang rtsi lta bu rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin te11/ de shing ljon pa'i drung de dag tu yang 'dod pa nyams dga' ba'i lha mo gzugs mi 12mdzes pa 1 med pa'i gzugs rnams dang lhan cig 'bras bu'i ros myos nas yun ring du dga' bar byed do/ /de nas de ltar bde ba la gnas shing rgyags pas myos pa'i lha dang lha mo'i tshogs de rnams bro gar dang / glu dbyangs dang / dgod pa'i sgra de dag thos shing /gang lha'i rgyal po brgya byin gyi rjes su 'gro la phyi bzhin du 'brang ba de rnams sgra de dag thos nas/ lha'i rgyal po brgya byin ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /de 69—311

ltar de dag thams cad brgya byin gyi drung du dong nas/ brgya byin la gsong por smras shing thal mo sbyar nas mgo bo 1gtugs te/ brgya byin la bsnyad pa/ lha'i dbang po 'di ltar blta nan sdug na gnas pa'i lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad skyed mos tshal du dga' spyod bgyid du mchi na/ lha'i dbang po de dag mkhyen par mdzod cig /de nas brgya byin de dag las tshig de thos nas/ lha rnams la 'di ltar blta rin sdug na gnas pa'i lha dag gang nas dong ba'i skyed mos tshal du bdag cag kun 'dong gis lakhyed rnams 'dong bar shoms shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas brgya byin gyis tshig de thos nas chos bzang na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyang shing rta rgyal mtshan sna tshogs can la zhon/ la la gser gyi shing rta rasrog shing bee ḍūrya las byas pa ba dan btags pa rnams la zhon/ la la bee ḍūrya'i shing rta srog shing gser las byas pa rnams la zhon/ la la ni rin po che sna bdun bkra zhing ba dan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa rnams la zhon/ la la gser gyi bya sgra snyan cing shin tu mdzes par 'byung ba'i bya'i shing rta rnams la zhon/ la la rta khra bo 'gros 'cham 6zhing bde ba dag la shing rtas blangs nas/ shing rta de rnams rta de rnams la btags te/ rta'i shing rtas 'gro bar byed/ de ltar gzhan yang gser gyi bya ngang pa rkang pa 7ni bee ḍūrya/ sgro ni pad ma rā 8)ga'i mdog lta bu rnams kyi steng du zhin nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang lhan cig tu blta rten sdug gi grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang / skyed mos tshal ga la ba yod pa der 'dong bar byed do/ /yang lha gzhan dag rin po che sna bdun gyi rma bya'i 1 gzugs dang ldan zhing / mdongs kyi tshogs kyis khebs pa gang mi'i 'jig rten na yang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa yin la lha'i 'jig rten na lha gzhan dang 11mi 69—312

'dra ba legs par byas pa'i las rnams kyis mngon par brgyan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag gi mdog sdug cing dbyibs legs pa dpe bya bar yang mi nus pa'i steng du zhon no/ /rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa de dag la gzhan dag zhon nas bltas1)na sdug gi skyed mos tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal ga la ba der 'dong bar byed de/ lha'i tshogs de rnams rol mo'i sgra dang / glu dbyangs sna tshogs kyis dgod cing rtse la yongs su spyod pa dang / lha gzhan myos shing 'khod pa rnams skyed mos tshal ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /lha'i rgyal po brgya byin gyi shing rta bzhi yang 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang legs par ldan pa/ shing rta rin po che sna bdun las byas pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ an da rnyil dang / pad ma rā ga dang / spug shin tu gsal ba dang / bai ḍūrya dang / byi ru dang / rdo rje dang ske/ shel la gser gyi khye'u 2rnams kyis mngon par brgyan pa/ shing rta'i mchog de la brgya byin zhon nas/ rin po che sna bdun gyi bya ngang pa gser gyi pad ma ltar rgyas shing / dbyibs dang / cha byad sna tshogs dang ldan pa sgra che zhing gdangs snyan pa 'byin pa de'i drung na lha mo'i dbyangs kyang snyan par mi 'gyur ba stong gis la khrid de/ brgya byin gyi 5shing rta rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa 6ngang 7pa rnams kyis khrid par byed do/ /shing rta de la yang tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis bsgyur ba'i 'phanam lnga brgya/ 'phan 9shing bee ḍūrya dang / gser dang dngul las byas pa la 7btags so/ /'phan 11gyi kha dog ni 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / btsod 12ka dang na/ dmar po dang / dkar pos ngamadzes par byas pa yin la/ shing rta de la lha'i rgyal po de zhon nas/ lha mo'i tshogs du ma ni nye ba na glu dbyangs len lha/ lha 'bum phrag du ma yang mdun du song nas glu dbyangs 69—313

len cing nam mkha' la ni 1yang dang yang du 'gro/ sa la nimatshonayang dang yang du 'gro ste/ gar dga' bar 'gro ba/ ci dgar byed pa/ lha'i bde ba de la snenye bar spyod cing sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pas nyams dga' bzhin du grong khyer blta can sdug dang / skyed mos tshal ga la ba 57der 'dong bar byed do/ /der 'dong ba na lha'i tshogs gzhan dag gis mthong nas bro gar 6byed/ gad mo dgod ske/ rtsed mo rtse/ rol mo byed cing pad ma sna tshogs sdong bu bee ḍūrya las byas pa dag lag tu khyer nas/ lha'i rgyal po brgya byin lha rnams dang lhan cig gang nas mngon du 'ong ba der blta 8na sdug pa na gnas pa'i lha de rnams kyis kyang skyed mos tshal nas byung nas 'ong ngo / /de nas brgya byin gyis bdag cag gi 9drung 'dir 'ong gis 1 khyed kyis 'di dag dang rtse ba de bya ba'i rigs so zhes kyang bsgo'o / /de nas brgya byin gyi kha nas tshig thos pa spyi bos blangs nas/ blta /1na sdug na gnas pa'i lha ga la ba der chu blang ba'i phyir brgyugs so/ /lha mo'i nang nas lha mo de dag kyang blta na sdug pa'i 12gnas pa'i nang du chu blang ba'i phyir brgyugs so/ /blta 1rin sdug na gnas pa'i lha mo dang / chos bzang na gnas pa'i lha mo dag kyang gang de nas phan tshun rgyug go/ /de ltar lha rnams phan tshun du gser gyi pad ma'i 'dab ma dag blangs nas skyed mos tshal ga la ba der rgyug la / de dag phan tshun lhan cig tu dgod cing rtse la rgyu'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin bar snang la rgyu zhing 'dug pas kyang lha dang lha mo rnams me tog ku mu das rtse ba de dag mthong ngo / /lha de rnams chu la yun ring du rtse ba de byas 1 nas/ de nas yang mchog ste/ pad ma la rtse ba rtsom par byed do/ /lha dang lha mo de dag phan tshun pad ma la rtse bar byed de/ la la gser gyi pad ma rnams kyis/ la la 69wa 314

bee ḍūrya dang gser gyi sdong bu rnams kyis/ la la sdong bu sna tshogs rnams kyis rtse ste de ltar phan tshun rtsed mo byed do/ /de ltar phan tshun yun ring du bstegs shing rtses nas/ 'bras bu'i tshal ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /de dag gis 'bras bu snyi ba rnams gi1blangs nas/ phan tshun steg 'dod pa 'phen par byed do / /'bras bu la rtse ba de yang byas nas chang gi tshal ga la yod pa der 'dong bar byed do/ /tshal der song nas myos pa'i skyon dang bral zhing 'khrug 5pa med pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin ro zhim pa las ji ltar byas pa bzhin du zhim pa dag la 'thung bar byed do/ /lha'i rgyal po brgya byin yang shing rta'i mchog de las babs nas lha'i kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der song ste/ de dag gi nang du 'dug go/ /lha'i rgyal po de rnams kyis mthong nas phan tshun kun yid dga' ste lha'i rgyal po la mchod pa 4byed do// //'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag 5pa/ bam po sum cu neganyis pa/ de ltar kun gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te mchod pa byas nas/ 'di ltar lha'i dbang po bzhugs pa bdag cag gi srog gi 'bras bu mchis pa lags te/lha'i rgyal po brgya byin ni gang bdag cag gi pha ma dag pas lhag par srog stsol ba lags so zhes smras nas/ de ltar brgya byin de la de rnams kyis legs par mchod do/ /de nas yang lha de dag la 'di skad ces khyed ni bdag gi bu dang 'dra / spun dang 'dra zhes smras nas de ltar de dag phan tshun legs par mchod pa byas te / de nas yang bag med pa'i sar zhugs nas/ bag med pa de nyid la gnas so/ /de nas yang tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dag bya'i tshogs rnams kyis 8sgra 'byin pa/ 'bab chu dang / klung dang / tshang tshing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/69—315

gser gyi chu bo pad ma'i tshal dang nye ba'i tshal mdzes par byas pa/ sa gzhi mnyam zhing 'jam la mi rtsub pa/ mtho 17dman gyis brgyan pa/ bai ḍūrya dang gser dang dngul dang shel gyi shing sngon pas brgyan pa/ bza' ba dang btung ba chu bo ltar 'bab cing 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ me tog man 'om ra dang pad ma la sogs pa me tog chen po rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa/ tshang tshing rnams kyi nang na lha'i mi dang bud med dgod dgod no/ rtse rtse rgal rgal yongs su spyad pas bsten pa'i tshang tshing gi tshal dang skyed mos tshal rnams su lha'i sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa dang lha'i kha zas dang / lha'i yul lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa rnams kyis kyang dga' bar byed do/ /de nas yang blta pa na sdug pa na gnas pa dang chos bzang na gnas pa dga' bar byed pa/ rang gi gnas gnas su zhugs so/ /de dag der zhugs nas kyang ji srid du 'dod pa yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du dga' bar byed do/ /de dag phyis lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin/ sems can dmyal ba dang yi dgas dang dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na / las de dang rgyu 'thun par de rtag tu shin tu bde bar 'gyur zhing / rig pa'i blo dri ma med pa dang / rol mo la dga' ba ste/ bro gar dang glu dbyangs dang dgod 6pa dang rtse ba la dga'/ rtag tu spro ba la dga' zhing bza' ba dang btung ba dang / bca' ba dang bza' bar bya ba mang po la dga' ba dang yams kyi nad med cing / rims nad med la mya ngan dang bral bar 'gyur ba mthong 69wa 316

ngo ske/ /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 1)shes pa de/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des na thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas lha rnams kyi gnas phyogs gcig na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ 'byor pa yang shin tu chung zhing dman par gyur pa gang gis gzhan dag rtso)las nor rdzas kyi45rnam pa'am/ kha zas dag blangs te/ shin tu sdug bsngal yang bu dang chung ma 'ba' zhig la mi sbyor bar sems yongs su bsgoms pa'i yid kyis nor rdzas sam/ kha zas de dag gzhan sdug bsngal zhing pha rol gzhan dag nyon mongs pa dang long ba dang dbul ba dang mgon med pa rnams la bgo bsha' byas nas sbyin par byed pa dang srog chags gzhan gyi chung ma la 'khrig56)pa'i dga' bas rab tu chags pa dag /gzhi des mngon par bzung ste / srog chad 7pa'i nyon mongs pa 'thob cing gshed ma'i lag tu bskur ba/lho phyogs kyi sgo nas khrid de srog gcod par 'gyur ba/na nyon mongs pa'i rnam pa de lta bu'i nang du chud pa las thar 9bar byas na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi dziganas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang legs par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i las shin tu rgya che ba byas shing yang dag par spyad pa de rang gi lus las kun nas 'od 'byung ste/ dper na nyi ma'i 'od 'byung ba bzhin no/ /yang 'od de dag gi kha dog sngon po dang / ser po dang / btsod ka 11dang / ljang gu 12dang /dkar por 'byung ste/ lha de'i 'od des lha'i 'jig rten gyi 'od gsal ba de 63—317

dag thams cad de nas yang bcu 'gyur bas lhag par gsal bar byed do/ /dper na gza' dang skar ma'i 'od kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gsal bar byed la/ de nas yang zla ba'i 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa de bzhin du/ lha de'i rang gi lus kyi 'od kyis lha'i gnas de dag thams cad brgyan pa bzhin rnam par gsal bar byed do/ /'od des gzugs phun sum tshogs pa de dag thams cad dang ldan pa'i lha de la/ lha de dag gis mngon par brtags 1te/ rnam pa de lta bu'i 5khyad par gang gi drung na lha gzhan de dag srin bu me khyer bzhin gsal ba med do / /lha'i ris der lha cade skyes ma thag tu lha mo de dag thams cad lha de ga la ba der rgyug cing skyes ma thag tu rgyan 5)thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste gang gi gtsug gi nor bu mthon ka chen po'i 'od kyis dpag tshad dag tu 'od snang bar byed pa bzhin du/ 'od gang gis gzhan mtho ris na gnas pa'i 'od de dag thams cad dang phyi rol gyi nor bu de dag thams cad de ltar zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /ji ltar nyi ma shar bas srin bu me khyer rnams kyi 'od zil gyis tsiganon par byed pa de bzhin du lha de dag zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /de nas skyes ma thag tu rin po che sna bdun gyi cod pan dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'phro ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'od kun gyis brgyan cing 'od zer 'byung la gang gis 7'od sngon po dang / ser 8)po dang / btsod ka 9dang / ljang gu khodang /dkar po dag 'byung bar 1 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu rin po che sna bdun gyi mgul rgyan 15dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'phro ba 1 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de'i 'og tu 7rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyan phreng 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu phreng ba 'phyang skab rdo rjes brgyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de'i 63—318

rked 1)pa'i phreng rgyan ji ltar 'ja'i kha dog lta bur skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de'i lham rin po che 2sna bdun gyis spras pa/ 'od sna tshogs dang ldan pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ shugs gang gis rim pa 'di 5ltar 'gro ba ni/gang gi tshe lha de 'di snyam du 'di ltar bdag 4che ge mo zhig tu nam mkha' las 'gro'o snyam du bsams na sems sgrubaskyed ma thag tu lha yul du 'byung ba'i lham nedes lha de bteg ste nam mkha' la khyer nas gnas der 'gro ste / lus ngal ba med cing gnod pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gang de'i 'og tu de'i gos thags su btags pa ma yin pa rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa 'od gsal ba 'byung b.ras 'gyur te/ gang gi 'od kyis lha'i ris nyams dga' ba de/ de nas yang shin tu 9nyams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /lha de skyes ma thag tu 'di snyam du sems te/ las byas pa gang gis bdag 'dir skyes shig gu snyam nas/ des brtags na las legs par byas pa dang nyes par byas pa'i gzhi 'dzam bu gling de nas bdag shi ste/ der gang bya ba legs par bya ba'am / nyes par byas pa de 'dir nye bar spyod par 'gyur te/ der bdag 11gis legs par byas pa'i las kyi rgyu des bdag 'dir skyes te/ rgyu med pas ni ma yin no snyam mo/ /de de ltar bsams pa dang thang cig tu 1 lha mo gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed pa thams cad 1 nye 1 bar 'ong bar byed de/ de dag gi rgyan gyi sgra ji ltar mi yul na sil snyan yan lag lnga dang shin tu ldan pa de dag gi sgra 'byung ba de ltar de 15rnams kyi sgra 'byung bar byed do/ /de dag gi dri yang dpag tshad gnyis su gang bar 'gyur te/ dri gang gis me tog thams cad kyi dri zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ de dag gi gzugs dang lang tsho sngon ma byung ba 'byung bar 69—319

'gyur zhing tshim pa dang dga' ba 'byung bar 'gyur la/ sngon gyi gos kyi yon tan rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha de'i legs par byas pa'i las des 'di lta ste/ nyi ma shar ba'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis me tog thams cad rab tu rgyas par 'gyur ba de ltar lha de'i 'od byung bas lha mo de dag thams cad kyi gzugs rab tu rgyas par 'gyur te/ de dag dang de phrad nas 'dzum zhing dga' ba dag gis rtsed mo byed do/ /de dag gis de pang du blangs te tshal dang nye ba'i tshal ga la ba de nyid du 'gros 1sdug gus khyer zhing lha de'i mdun du sil snyan sna tshogs dang dgod napa'i sgras dga' bar byed pa de dag lha la lta 5)zhing tshal dang nye ba'i tshal de dag ga la ba der 'dong 4ribar byed do/ /lha de'i gnas su tshal 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ pad ma rmad byung gi tshal yod degaci/ tshal de na gang gi tshe/ lha de 'jug pa de'i tshe/ gom pa 'dor ba'i sa dag la pad ma sdong bu ni bee ḍūrya/ myu gu ni rdo rje/ snying po ni gser/ lo ma ne'ajam zhing 'dab ma 'jam pa dang bung ba'i tshogs kyis mdzes par byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de dag la lha de'i rkang pa gnyis 'jog par byed do/ /de nas rkang pa bteg pa dang pad ma gzhan dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhing snga ma zhum par 'gyur ro / /de pad ma'i tshal de nas sbrang rtsi'i chu'i tshal zhes bya ba sbrangs rtsi'i chu'i tshal ga la ba der 'dong bar byed de/ tshal de na lha'i shing ljon pa gser las byas pa de dag thams cad las lha'i rgyan chang 'dzag ste/ lha'i ro dang dri dang ldan pa'i rgyan chang de dag la lha'i mchog de 'thung bar byed de/ myos pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i sbrang rtsi de dag la lha de 8rnams 'thung bar byed do/ /dri dang ro sngon ma byung ba de dag la 'thungs nas kyang tshal gsum mdzes zhes bya ba ga la ba der 69—320ri

'dong bar byed do/ /der gsum mdzes dpe med pa 'byung ste/ 'di lta ste/bya dang bung ba'i tshogs sgra 'byin 1pa dang / gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sgra dang lha mo rol mo byed pa 'byung ngo / /lha'i mchog de tshal gsum mdzes de na skyed mos tshal nas na/skyed mos tshal dang nye ba'i /tshal nas nye ba'i tshal dang / pad ma'i rdzing nas pad ma'i rdzing dang / lteng ka nas lteng kur cadaga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed do/ /bya sgra sna tshogs 'byin pa la nyan cing dbang po lnga yul lnga la tshim pa med pa'i yid srid 5pa'i mes sreg pa na/ ji srid du de'i legs par byas pa'i las ma zad pa de srid du dga' bar byed do/ /de las de zad nas de nas yang lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las kyi thag pas bcings pa rang gis byas pa'i las rnams kyis sems 6can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro//gal te mi'i so so yang dag par myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyis mi rnams kyi nang du skyes na/ las de dang rgyu 'thun par de gzugs dang rigs dang yon tan phun sum tshogs shing kun nas mchog tu bde ba dang ldan pa dang rang dang 'brel ba las 'tsho zhing gzhan la rag ma lus 7pa dang rang 'dod pa bzhin spyod cing nad med pa dang gnod pa med pa dang tsher ma med pa dang shin tu 'byor pa dang de bzhin du gsum ldan gyi dus su'am de bzhin du gtso bo'i nang du'am/ de bzhin du rgyal srid phyed la dbang ba'am/ rgyal tshab bam/ tshong pa 'byor pa'i 8mchog nor dang 'bru dang gser dngul thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ba mthong ngo ske/ /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des 9thos pa las byung 69wa 321

ba'i shes pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas shing gseb na gnas pa zhes 1ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ gang gis rkun po chad pas bcad 2par 'os pa bzung ba/ gang 'jig rten pha rol la 'jigs pa'i bsam dpas/ de la chad pas mi gcod cing gnod par mi byed pa dang pha rol gzhan gyis rkun po bzung 4ba de yang sems can la phan par 'dod pa / byams par gzhol ba'i sems dang ldan pa'i bsam pas thar bar byed pa dang ske/ ma la yang mal cha dang na ba'i rkyen gyi gso sman dang / yo byad sbyin par byed cing gong ma'i rdzas bsgrubs pa de dag rku ba'i sems kyis mi rku ba dang /tshig 'jam zhing tshig nyung la phan par smra ba dang / nyin gcig bzhin sangs rgyas la gus par phyag 'tshal zhing 5/ sangs rgyas la spos sam me tog gam bdug 46pa dag phul te phyag 'tshal la / de'i yon tan yang rjes su dran pa dang / bla ma la lus kyis kyang gus par byed cing myur du ldang ba dang / gus par phyag 'tshal ba dang / rtag tu snyan par smra ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po mthong na shin tu 'dre bar mi byed la/ de dag dang lhan cig dga' ba dang 'gro ba dang phrad pa dang mngon par smra bar mi byed/ mi nyon mongs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/'phags pa ma yin pa/ 'jig rten pas spangs pa rnams dang lhan cig dga' bar mi byed la/ thad kur lta zhing 'dug par mi byed pa dang / rgan po la legs par lta 8ste rgan po shes pa dang ldan pa/ sems can la byams shing pha rol gdung bar mi byed pa/ 'jig rten kun gyis bkur ba/ snyan par smra ba/'jam por smra ba dag la bsnyen bkur byed cing / yang dag par rnam par 69wa 322

'byed 1)pa'i tshul khrims kyang yod pa dang / bran pho nadang / bran mo dang /las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la rgyu med par 'tshe ribar mi byed pa dang ske/ bza' ba mang du mi za ba dang / 'dod dgur 'gro ba'i tshul du mi byed pa dang / gnod pa'i tshul med pa dang / glo bur du mi 'khrug pa dang / shan pa dang / nyo tshong45dang / khyi yis 'tsho ba dang / nyis ne'atsho ba dri ma dang bcas pa la sogs pa dang / nyo tshong la sogs pa chos ma yin pa dang yang dag par 'brel bar mi byed pa dang / chang 'tshong gi khyim du dga' ba med pa dang ske/ bud med la rag las shing sdig pa byed pa dang / spyod pa nyams pa dang ske/ rtab rtab 7nopor mi 'gro ba dang / smra ba na gzhan gyi gsang mi shor ba dang ske/ grogs po rnams la glags lta zhing gsang ste dgra mi byed pa dang / gnad btsal te rgyal po la mi smra ba dang / gzhan gyi zhing rnams la skye ba'i ldum ra mthong na 8)bdag nyid kyir mi byed pa dang / yul mi'i dpya 9nar ma drug cha gcig 'bul ba las lhag par mi 'bebs pa dang / gzhan gyi zhing dang / chu dang ske/ skal ba byin pa mi 'phrog pa dang / mtshan mo'am nyin mo gzhan gyi 'bras bu mi 'phrog pa dang / rku sems thams cad dang bral ba'am re re dang bral ba'am/ nyung ngur bral ba yin te/ ji ltar na 1 nyung ngur bral ba yin zhe na/ las kyi nyer bsdogs mi byed pa dang / las bar ma dang bral ba yin te/gang byas pa 'chags par byed cing skyon du rtsi la mi byed pa dang chen po dang bral ba yin te/ las kyi nyer bsdogs mi byed pa dang de bzhin 11byed du mi 'jug cing ske/ gzhan gyis byas nas kyang 'chags su 'jug pa dang / so sor rjes su yi rang bar mi byed pa dang mi ngan pa de rnam par 1 spong bar byed la/ chung ngu 69wa 323

dang 'bring dang chen po byed pa de chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i 'bras bu la spyod pa yin te/ de ltar legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' spyod pa/ nyes par byed pa 1rnam par spangs 5pa de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de der skyes nas kyang 5lha'i lus sha dang rus pa dang rnag khrag dang bral ba yin te/gang bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba de'i dpe bya bar yang sla ba ma yin mod kyi/ cung zad cig dper bya na 'di lta ste/ sems can gang sems can dmyal ba yang sos 4su skye ba dang gang gser gyi 'khor los sgyur 5)ba'i rgyal po'i khyad par gang yin pa dang lha'i bde ba myong ba'i mi 'khor los sgyur46)ba'i rgyal po gling bzhi pa'i rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa'i khyad par gang yin pa'i khyad par de ni shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha de'i dper cung zad bya ba yin no/ /shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha de ri rab kyi steng dpag tshad sum stong yod par dpal dang ldan pa rin po che sna bdun gyi lha'i shing ljon pa dang chu bos mdzes par byas pa lta bur/phyogs de na 7tshal kun spyod ces bya ba gser gyi shing ljon pa yod pa der 'di ltar lha rnams kyi sems la gang du bdag cag 'gro bar bya ba der shing ljon pa dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du de ltar 'ong bar shog shig snyam mo/ /de sems bskyed ma thag 8nyid du shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha rnams gar 'gro ba de dag gi phyi bzhin du de ltar 'ong ste/ dper na/ 'khor los sgyur 9ba'i rgyal po sems bskyed ma thag nyid du 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'gro ba de ltar lha rnams kyi sems bskyed ma thag nyid du shing 7ljon pa dag nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /lha rnams gar 'dod pa der yang sa'i 11steng du 'bab par 'gyur te/ dper 1rten bya dag 63—324

sa'i phyogs gang dang gang du 'gro zhing gnas pa de dang de nyid du gnas par 'gyur ba de bzhin du shing ljon pa de dag thams cad de ltar 'gyur te/ 'di ni shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyi rang gis byas pa'i las kyi mthu gcig yin nol/ /de nas yang mthu 'byung ste/ de ltar legs par byas pa'i las de dag gi mthu ni lha rnams gang du 'dong ba der bya dag sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa lta bu'i sgra 'byin te)bzhin du phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'dong ngo / /de nas gzhan yang legs par byas pa'i las rnams kyi mthu ni lha rnams nam mkha' la 'dod pa dang bcas par 'gro ba'i lha dag pad ma'i rdzing na bung ba myos pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang gser gyi bya ngang pas mdzes par byas shing / bya kā raṇḍa 5ba dang ngur pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis /legs par byas pa'i mthu ni lha/lha'i phreng ba dang gos gyon pa dag nam mkha' gang la 'gro ba'i nam mkha' der/lha'i pad ma sdong bu bee ḍūrya las byas pa'i gnas dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/'dab ma stong yod pa'i 'dab ma de re re la lha mo 'khod nas/ lha ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /de nas yang shing gseb na gnas pa'i legs par byas pa rnams kyi las kyi mthu ni lha dag lha'i pad ma la 'dug nas gang du 'gro ba der nam mkha' de las lha'i btung bas gang ba'i lha'i snod dag lag tu 'ong ste/btung ba de dag lha dang lha mo de dag dang lhan cig 'thung zhing dga' bar byed/glu dbyangs len/ yongs su spyod par byed la/ phyogs gzhan gang du 'dong bar yang 'gro'o/ /de nas gzhan yang shing gseb na gnas pa rnams kyi las kyi mthu ni lha rnams gang dang gang 'dod pa de dang de thams cad 'byor bar 'gyur 69wa 325

zhing ske/ lha'i 'jig rten gyi gnas nas gnas gzhan du rnam pa gang gzhan gyis 'gro 'dod pa'i ri dang ri'i rtse mo de dag tu yang lha'i me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ chu bo phun sum tshogs pa dang tshal dang nye ba'i tshal phun sum tshogs pa dag nam mkha' las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha gnas pa de rnams lha mo dag gis yongs su bskor la lhan cig tu lha'i sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i glu dbyangs nye ba na len cing / de dag nyid dang yul nas yul du nam mkha' la 'gro ba na/ de nas chos bzang na gnas pa dang 1blta nan sdug pa na gnas pa yid dga' bas gnas mthon po mthong ste/ ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na mi rgyu ba dag lha gzhal med khang gsal ba na gnas pas mthong ba bzhin no/ /de ltar chos bzang na gnas pa'i lha de dag dang blta rin sdug can gnas pa'i lha de dag phan tshun du kye 'di ltar shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha de dag bde ba mchog dang ldan te/ bdag cag pas khyad ches bde la/ lha'i sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa dag nye bar len cing gar ridaga' dgur 6rgyu ba/ gar 'dod par 'gro ba / ci bder gnas/ thogs pa med par 'gro ba/ yul nas yul du 'gro'o zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po brgya byin yang pad ma 'dab ma stong la sdong bu lha'i gser dang bee ḍūrya las byas pa'i steng du 'dug nas/ lha mo bzang mos47dag dang lhan cig nam mkha' las 'gro'o/ /legs par byas pa'i las kyis sprul pa'i pad ma de yang nyams dga' ba na'adi lta bu yin te/ 'dab ma thams cad la 9lha mo lha'i phreng ba dang gos gyon pa gser gyi 1 rgyan gyis brgyan 1 pa thams cad yid rab tu dga' ba/ thams cad sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i dga' bas myos pa thams cad brgya byin la phyogs pa/ so so gzugs dang lang 69wa 326

tsho dar la bab pa'i dregs pas myos pa lnga 'khod de/ de dag thams cad lha'i rgyal po brgya byin dang lhan cig tu shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha rnams ga la ba 1der nam mkha' las 'dong bar byed do/ /shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha de dag gis kyang brgya byin de mthong nas phyir zhing yid rab tu dga' la/ yang ji ltar bshad pa'i gnas de dag las babs nas/ lha'i rgyal po brgya byin ga la ba der 'dong bar byed do/ /dong nas brgya byin de la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te tshig gis kyang bstod do/ /brgya byin gyi sngon du 'gro ba dang / shing gseb na gnas pa'i lha snying dga' ba rnams kyis brgya byin de yongs su bskor nas/ brgya byin mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas sam/ skyed mos tshal lam/ ri bo'i steng ngam/ tshal lam / nye ba'i tshal lam/ pad ma'i rdzing ngam/ gnas gzhan ga la ba der nam mkha' las 'dong bar byed do/ /brgya byin gyi sngon du 'gro ba de rnams der yun ring du rtses ri nas/ de nas yang rang gi gnas ga la ba der 'dong bar byed de/ brgya byin gyi sngon du 'gro ba rnams ji ltar song ba de ltar slar 'ong bar byed do/ /de nas brgya byin yang lha'i 'dun sa chos bzang ga la ba der 'gro bar byed do/ /gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya sdug gus camyos pa'i lha de dag kyang ji srid du sdug pa 'dod pa/ yid du 'ong ba byas shing bsags pa'i las de zad par ma gyur pa de srid du dga' bar byed do/ /de phyis lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang las nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi rnams 5dang skal ba mnyam par mi'i nang du skyes na ri/ las de dang rgyu 'thun par de rtag tu bde ba mchog dang ldan zhing 69—327

rtag tu nad med pa dang / gnod pa med pa dang / nor dang shin tu ldan zhing mchog tu bde ba dang / de bzhin du sde gzhan gyis 'jigs pa med pa'i bar gyi gling dag gi rgyal por 'gyur ba'am rgyal tshab tu 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des thos pa las byung7)ba'i shes pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas shing rta sna tshogs na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas/ des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ mchod rten gyi gnas rnams su sngon yo byad sbyar ba rnams rgyal po mi rigs pa'am/blon po mi rigs pa'am/ nami rigs par chags pa la brkam pa/ las la 'jigs pa med pa/ gang gis gcod par byed pa la skyes bu dam pa yid dang ri sems bsgoms pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mngon par dran pa'am tshig shin tu snyan cing gsal bas sangs rgyas la bstod nas de phyir zlog par byed dam 'tshob par cabyed na/ de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi 5)nang shing rta 6sna tshogs na gnas pa'i sar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang shin tu dge ba'i las byed pa de sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pas dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed / gnas par byed do/ /sa der las kyi 'bras bu gzhan gyis kyang skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa ri spangs pas 'gyur te/'di lta ste/ khyis 'tsho ba las ri dgas thar bar byed la/ bdag nyid kyang mi byed / byed du yang mi 'jug /gzhan gyis byas pa la rjeg su yi rang bar yang 69—328

mi byed pa dang / ji ltar ma byin par len pa mi byed de/ ma byin par len pa ji ltar spangs pa yin zhe na/ bdag nyid yul gyi bdag po'am/ rgyal po'am/blon por gyur pas pha rol la chad pas gcod par mi byed cing / gzhan byed pa yang zlog par byed la/ chos sam khrims la 'jog par byed pa de dag ni shing rta sna tshogs su skyes par 'gyur ba'i las rnam pa gnyis pa yin no/ /tshal gyi rgyaram1dpag tshad sum stong yod pa de na/ lha dag shing rta sna tshogs rnams kyis dga' bar byed de/ des na shing rta sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i ming du btags nal/ shing rta sna tshogs der gnas pa'i lha rnams rtse bar byed do/ /shing rta dang shing rta'i nang na gser dang dngul gyi pad ma 'dab ma bai ḍūrya shin tu blta can sdug pa/dri mchog tu yid du 'thad pa'i rdzing 'byung la/ bung ba bee ḍūrya'i mdog 5lta bu'i tshogs lding ba rnams kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /tshal der bkra ba 'di dag kun 'byung bar 'gyur te de brjod pa/ pad ma'i rdzing rnams su pad ma bkra ba 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ pad ma la la pad ma'i phyed mthon ka las byas pa/ phyed bai ḍūrya las byas pa yin te bkra ba gcig yin no/ /yang bkra ba gzhan ni phyed bai ḍūrya las byas la/ phyed gser las byas pa yin te bkra ba gzhan ri yin no/ /yang bkra ba gzhan 7ni pad ma na'adab ma brgya pa thams cad kyis pad ma la pad ma byed kyi pad ma'i 'dab ma ni gser las byas la gzhan ni pad ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu yin no/ /yang bkra ba gzhan 'byung ba ni/ pad ma bee ḍūrya'i 'dab ma dag la bung ba gser gyi mdog can rgyu la/ dngul gyi 'dab ma dag la bung ba pad ma rā ga'i mdog can rgyu'o/ /yang bkra ba gzhan 'byung ba ni bee ḍūrya'i pad ma'i sdong bu la ni gser gyis yongs su dkris/69—329

gser gyi pad ma'i sdong bu la ni rin po ches yongs su dkyis0)/ dngul gyi pad ma'i sdong bu la ni spug gis yongs su dkris/ rin po che ma rgad〈gekyi kha dog lta bu'i sdong bu la ni 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyis yongs su dkris so/ /bung〈mib sgra 'byin pa kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs su 'dug pa rnams kyis 54 pad ma'i rdzing bu de dag khebs pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ 'dzam bu'ilos)gling na me tog tsu la sa'i dog pa la bung ba rnams kyis rtag tu khebs pa ltar shing rta sna tshogs kyi yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas legs par byas pa'i las rnams kyis gnas sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ 'dzam bu'i56ragling na lag bzo mkhas pa'am / lag bzo'i slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis/ rtsig57)ngos la bkra ba 'dab ma sna tshogs bkod pa/ tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis bris pa ltar/ tshal gyi gnas de na yang de lta bu yin no/ /yang shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal gyi bkra ba gzhan ni bya sna tshogs kyi sgro dang / rkang pa dang / mgo dang / lto dang / mig bkra ba dag 'byung ste/ 'di lta ste/ bya gang gi58)lto gser du 'dug pa de'i sgro dngul47yin la / rgyab pad ma rā ga'i mdog dang / mig rin po che ke ke ru'i mdog /de bzhin du gang dngul47gyi ltor 'dug pa de'i sgro gser la/ mig bai ḍūrya'i mdog dang mig gi 'bras bu pad ma rā ga'i mdog la rgyab bkra bar 'dug ste/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mdog lta bu'i bya sna tshogs rnams kyis nye bar mdzes par byas hu)so / /'di ni shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal gyi bkra ba gzhan yin te/ 'di lta ste/ri'i rtse mo 'byung ba dang / 'di lta ste/ mthon ka dang / bee ḍūrya dang /spug dang / rin po che ke ke ru dang gser te/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis tshal de spras shing brgyan pa yin no/ /tshal de phan tshun gyi 'od zer 'khyil pas shin tu 69—330

gang la/ lha'i 'od zer gyi mthus shin tu mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /yang tshal sna tshogs bkra ba gzhan ni lcug ma 'phyang ba dang / shing gel pa sna tshogs dag phan tshun 'dzings par 'dug la/ kha dog gsum 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/bee ḍūrya'i lcug ma la pad ma rā ga'i mdog gi 'bras bu de 'phyang bar 'gyur zhing /an ༅)da rnyil gyi mdog lta bus lhan cig dkris pa yin/ dngul gyi lcug ma la pad ma rā ga'i mdog gi 'od kyis lhan cig bskor ba yin/ de bzhin du spug dang ske/ gser gyi lcug ma/ la gser gyi lcug mas lhan cig dkris pa yin/ 'di lta ste/ rin po che ke ke ru'i mdog lta bu'i lcug ma la dngul gyis yongs su dkris pa yin te/ de ltar lcug ma kha dog gnyis pa 'phyang ba yongs su dkris pa yin rnam/ /lhug ma 'phyang ba kha dog gsum pa rnams la yongs su dkris pa ni 'di lta ste / bee ḍūrya'i lhug ma la gser dang / ke ke ru'i mdog lta bus kun du dkris pa yin/ de bzhin du lcug ma ke ke ru'i mdog lta bu la/ gser dang dngul lta bus yongs su dkris pa yin/ de bzhin du dngul gyi lcug ma la pad ma spug dang /mthon ka lta bus yongs su dkris pa yin te/ de ltar lcug ma re re la gnyis gnyis kyis kun du dkris pa yin no/ /yang shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal du bkra ba gzhan 'byung ba ni/ gser gyi lcug ma dag las me tog bai ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu 'byung ske/ de bzhin du dngul gyi lcug ma dag las me tog mthon ma'i mdog lta bu 'byung ske/ de bzhin du gser gyi lcug ma dag las me tog ke ke ru'i mdog lta bu 'byung ske/ de bzhin du spug gi lhas ma dag las me tog bee ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu 'byung ste/ de ltar lcug ma sna tshogs dag las me tog sna tshogs dag 'byung ngo / /las sna tshogs kyis bskyed pa/ sems sna tshogs kyis bslang ba2/ rgyu sna tshogs 69wa 331

dang 'thun pa ni yang dag par skyes pa sna tshogs dag yin te/ de ltar las rnams kyi rgyu dang gzhi des/ de ltar shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal thams cad bkra ba yin no/ /ji ltar sa bon las 'bras bu 'byung ba de bzhin du rgyu dang 'thun par 'bras bu 'byung ste/ gang 'dir las byed pa rnam pa gang ji ltar 'phangs pa dang ske/ gang gi tshe zhing gi rnam pa ji lta bu dang / sems pa'i rnam pa ji lta bu nas /1 sna tshogs su slong bar byed pa'i bar gyi na las rnam pa sna tshogs byas pa'i 'bras bu ni de ltar rgya'i 'bur lta bur 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtho ris sam sems can dmyal ba gang rgyu med par 'bras bu 'byung ba de med de/ gzhan rigyis byas la rnam par smin pa gzhan la 'byung bam de ni gnas med do/ /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal bkra ba dang / 'jig rten bkra ba la yang mu rtog par byed de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i shing rta sna tshogs na lha rnams las 6)ci zhig byed cig gu 7 snyam nas/des thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ 'di ltar dus gang gi tshe/ mi chos dang mi ldan pa chos ma yin pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ mar mi 'dzin pa/ phar mi 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa/ rigs kyi rgan rabs la gus par mi byed pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mi 'dzin pa/las dang 'bras bu la yid mi ches pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba med pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba'i sngon du 'gro ba med pa de'i 85tshe/ bdud sdig can dag dga' bar 'gyur la/ de'i chos dang chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'khor bzhi po de dag 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ bdud kyi ris 'jig rten skyong ba 'thab pa 9zhes bya ba dang / bdud kyi ris 'jig rten skyong ba g.yeng 69wa 332

byed ces bya ba gang chos spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems g.yeng bar byed pa'am / dam pa'i chos nyan pa gnyid log par byed pa dang / gsum pa lhag par chags par rmongs 1pa zhes bya ba sbyin pa dag gtong ba na/ sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi sems chags pa skyed 5par byed de/ 'di ltar bdag gis gang dge sbyong dang / bram ze zhing du gyur pa rnams la sbyin du bdag gi bu dang chung ma ci bza' ci bgo snyam du sems par byed de/ bdud kyi ris 'jig rten skyong ba gsum pa dag sems can rnams rnam par rmongs par byed cing / 'jig rten na rgyu bar byed do/ /bdud kyi ris 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi pa 'du shes log pa zhes bya ba de 'jig rten na rgyu zhing / de rab tu 'byung ba rnams kyi sems rab tu mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni chags pa dang / sbyor ba dang /grong du 'jug pa dang / tshong zong nyo tshong byed pa dang / bud med la lta 'dod pa dang / chang 'tshong 5gi khyim du 'jug pa dang / 'thab rtsod dang / dge 'dun 'byed pa dang / rmi lam gyi gnod pa'i sems skyed par byed do/ /bdud kyi ris 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po de dag gang gi tshe/ chos dang mi ldan pa'i skye dgu 'dzam bu'i gling du byed par 5nus pa dang ldan pa 'byung ba de'i tshe/bdud sdig can dag la lha dag dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs ni 'grib bo/ /bdud kyi phyogs ni 'phel te dgyes par mdzod cig ces bsnyad do/ /de dag las thos nas bdud sdig can dag gi 6rjes su 'brang ba 7de dag la/ bdag cag gi phyogs ji ltar 'phel/ dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs ji ltar 'gribs zhes dris so/ /de dag gis lha 'dzam bu'i nagling na mi chos ma yin pa dang ldan pa/ chos ma yin pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ mar mi 'dzin pa/ phar mi 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong du mi 69wa 333

'dzin pa/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa/ rigs kyi rgan rabs kyi rjes su mi 'jug 1pa / bdag cag gi 'dod chags kyi chags pas zil gyis mnan cing / dam pa'i chos mnyan 5pa la yang gnod pas bgyid do/ /de nas parab tu 'byung ba'i blos phal cher rab tu byung ba rnams dang / khyim na gnas pa sdom pa blangs shing /tshangs par spyod pa rnams kyi rmi lam du yang bud med kyi gzugs su sprul nas/rmi lam gyi gnod pa bgyid du stsal/ sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi sbyin pa gtong ba na/ bu dang chung ma la rag las pa'i sems kyis yid chags par gyur pa bgyis/ yid mdza' ba dang 'khrugs par bgyis/ rab tu byung ba yang nyo tshong gi zong la sems brtson par bgyis/ 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / mtshang 'drud pa la 5dga' bar bgyis te/ de ltar bdag cag gi thabs 'di rnams kyis bdud kyi phyogs ni spel6/ dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs ni bshig go zhes smras so/ /bdud sdig can gyis de thos nas/ lha ma yin sgra gcan dang /brtan pa dang / rab dgod dang / gzhan dag dang / klu rab 'joms 7la sogs pa dag la 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni yongs su dmas 2so/ /bdag cag gi phyogs ni 'phel te/ khyed dga' bar gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de ltar yang 'jig rten skyong ba de dag nyid yang sa'i 'og tu gtong bar byed de/sa'i 'og tu song nas/ rab dgod dang thags 9bzangs ris la snga ma bzhin du bsnyad do/ /de thos nas lha ma yin rnams rab tu dga' ste/ klu rab 'joms 1 la sogs pa chos dang mi ldan zhing / chos kyi rjes su mi 'jug pa rnams la bsnyad do / /longs spyod ldan na gnas pa'i klu de rnams kyis thos nas kyang shin tu dga' ste/ de dag mi rnams la snga ma bzhin du bgegs byed do/ /de dag kyang 63—334

'phags skyes po la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba gzhan dag las/ de dag thams cad snga ma bzhin du thos nas/ lha'i rgyal po brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang lhan cig shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal du 'jug par byed do/ /de zhugs nas lha rnams bos te/ 'di ltar 'jig rten skyong ba 'di dag na re/ 'di ltar bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams rab tu mthu dang ldan 1te/ lha ma yin thags 2bzangs ris dang rab dgod la sogs pa dang / klu rab 'joms la sogs pa mthu rab tu che'o zhes zer gyis / de la lha khyed cag gis lha'i tshogs thams cad 'dir bsdu ba'i 5rigs so/ /'dus nas kyang bdag cag lha'i tshogs thams cad lha ma yin dang g.yul sprad pa'i phyir/ rin po ches brgyan pa'i khang par brtsegs pa sna tshogs su 'dong ngo / /de thos nas lha thams cad kyis de ltar 'tshal lo 7zhes smras nas/ rang gi gnas ga la ba der 'dong ngo / /dong nas lha gzhan thams cad bsdus nas/ mdor bsdus te/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal ga la ba der 'dong ngo / /dong nas skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs kyi gnas nyid du 'khod cing / sil snyan sgra dbyangs sna tshogs dang glu dag len pa na/shing rta sna tshogs kyis bkra ba rnams su dga' bar byed do/ /gang shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na rtag pa rtag pa nyid du 'khod pa'i lha de dag ni skyed mos tshal gar yang mi 'gro'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po des lha 8de dag bsdus nas/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal de nas dong ngo / /shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na gnas pa'i lha de dag kyang ji srid du 'dod pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba byas shing / bsags pa'i las zad par ma gyur pa de srid du de na dga' bar byed do/ /de zad nas lha'i ris de nas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ shi nas kyang nye bar 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin 69wa 335

sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas 1dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi rnams kyi nang du skyes na/ las de dang rgyu 'thun par de rtag tu bde bar 'gyur zhing / na tshod thog ma nas 'chi ba'i bar du me tog gi phreng ba sdug gu thogs shing / cha byad sna tshogs dang shing rta sna tshogs la dga' ba dang skye bo kun dga' bar 'gyur/ gal te de rab tu byung na de seng ge'i khri la 'dug nas chos dang gtam sna tshogs smra ba dang / gtam sna tshogs kyis 'khor kyang kun nas shin tu dga' bar byed pa mthong ngo / /de nas yang dge slong las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa shes pa de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas la rtog par byed de/ des nathos pa las byung ba'i shes pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas dga' ba na gnas pa zhes bya ba ji ltar 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der sems can dag las gang gis skye bar 'gyur snyam nas / des 5thos pa las byung ba'i shes pas brtags na/ skyes bu dam pa bsam pa dge bar gyur pa gang gis srog gcod par mi byed cing ma byin par len pa yang mi byed la/ byed du ma bcug /pha rol byed pa yang bzlog /bdag nyid mi byed/ byed du mi 'jugazi/ /byas na yang 'chags 6par byed cing skyon du 'grang 7bar byed la sdig pa'i grogs po de yongs su spong bar byed do//de la srog gcod pa dang bral ba ni gang yin/ rnam pa ni du yod cig gu snyam nasate/ 'di ni bya ne'u bzung ba 8thar bar byed cing sdom pa len du bcug nas bdag nyid mi byed la so sor 'chags par byed pa'am/ bya pas bya bzung ba nor rdzas kyis bslus 9te thar bar byed la/ gzhan yang de nyid la rab tu 'jog par byed/ rab tu dga' bar byed/ rab tu spro bar byed pa dang / ma 69—336

byin par len pa spangs pa ji lta bu yin/ ma byin par len pa spangs pa gang yin zhig gu snyam na/ 'dir sdud pa por gyur nas grong rnams 'dzin tam/ tshong rdal lam/ grong rdal lam/ phyugs kyi lhas 'dzin pa'am/ rgyal pos 'di ltar lug dang ba lang dang bong bu la sogs pa sdus 1shig ces bsgo ba las/ de yang sdom pa'i 'jigs pas skrag nas ma byin par len pa mi byed na/ de lus nadang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang dga' ba'i tshal du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /las gzhan gyis kyang 'gyur te/ chos 'chad 95)pa yang chos nyan pa po rnams dga' bar bya ba'i phyir tshes grangs dang /yul dang / dus dang ldan par byas la de dag kyang dga' bar byas te/ de dag yid rab tu dga' ba sems rtse gcig gis chos nyan na/ dam pa'i chos 'chad ri4)pa'i slob dpon de lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dga' ba'i tshal du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa thams cad kyi nang na sbyin pa'i mchog 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ chos kyi 5sbyin pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyu 'dis kyang lus dang bral nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang na dga' ba'i tshal du skye 6bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de lha'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa 7dpe med pa brgya phrag stong du ma myong ba na/'di ltar gang du tshal de'i phyogs kyi cha ni 'di yin te/ dpag tshad sum stong yod la rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa rnams kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa yin te/ der 8lha rnams rtag tu dga' bar byed cing / gzhan gar yang mi 'gro ste/ de bas na lhan cig skyes pa'i yon tan gyis de dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya'o / /de na 9shing ljon pa thams cad 'dod pa dag gang 1 lha rnams kyi yid 69wa 337

kyis 1yang dag par sems par byed pa de dag nyid lha de rnams kyis shing ljon pa las 'thon 2par 'gyur te/ 'di /ltar lha rnams kyi yid la bdag khyim zhig 'dod do snyam na/ de nas de ltar lha des cayid la byas ma thag tu/ shing ljon pa de'i yal ga'i rtse mo las 5'byung bar 'gyur tene/ shing ljon pa de'i khang bzangs 7rin po che sna bdun dang ldan zhing nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ ka ba stong yod pa'i khang bzangs namathong bar 'gyur ro/ /khang pa de'i ka ba so sor de'i phyogs phyogs bee ḍūrya las byas shing / la la gser las byas/ la la shel las byas/ la la ke ke ru las byas/ la la spug las byas pa yin no/ /de nas khyim gyi mchog de 9shing ljon pa'i rtse mo de la yod pa mthong nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ da 1 ni bdag lam 'jam zhing mthon dman du gyur pa 11nas/khyim 'dir 'jug par bya'o snyam bsams ma thag nyid du shing ljon pa de nyid la 12lam mthong ste der 'jug par byed do/ /de ltar lam de nyid nas zhugs pa dang /de 'di snyam du sems te/ da ni bdag gi khyim 'dir khyim 1snyenang du pad ma'i rdzing zhig yod na rung ngo snyam mo/ /de sems bskyed ma thag nyid du pad ma'i rdzing rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ bya ngang pa dang / kā raṇḍa 1 ba dang / ngur pa sna tshogs kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa 'byung ngo/ /de nas yang lha de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs yan lag lnga dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig snyam mo/ /de sems bskyed ma thag nyid du gang rlung ngad 'jam pa rab tu ldang bar 'gyur te/ rnam pa ji srid du phan tshun reg dpa na sgra 'byung ba'i rnam pa de srid du sil snyan yan lag lnga dang laldan pa 'byung ngo //lha de 'di snyam du sems te/ shing ljon pa'i nang gi khang par da 1 ni bza' ba 69wa 338

dang ske/ btung ba chu bo ltar 'bab par gyur cig snyam mo/ /de sems bskyed ma thag nyid du shing ljon pa'i yal ga de dag rdol nas/ bza' ba chu bo snyed 1dang btung ba chu bo snyed kha dog dang / ro dang / reg pa phun sum tshogs pa byung nango ske/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ da ni bdag bdud rtsi bza' bar bya'o snyam mo / /de sems bskyed ma thag nyid du bdud rtsi lha'i ro dang / dri dang /mdog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ de de ril za bar byed do/ /de des shin tu tshim pa dang / de nas yang lha mo de rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/yongs su spyod par byed de(8)/ de ltar dga' ba'i tshal du lha dag shing gi drung du song ste bde ba nye bar spyod par byed do/ /de gal te yang shing ljon pa'i mchog de las 'bebs55)par byed de / de sa'i steng du song 7nas sa nade la 'chag par byed do/ /de 'chag pa na bai ḍūrya'i sdong bu dang ldan pa'i pad ma 9gser gyi 'dab ma mtho ris su 'os pa/ 'jam zhing 'phar 1 ba kun nas mchog tu nyams dga' zhing / shin tu dri zhim pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag la rkang pas 'gro zhing lha de 'chag par byed la/ lha'i sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i dbyangs len pa na(me/ de ltar lha de rkang pas 'chag 1 pa'i bde ba nye bar myong ngo / /de rnam par rtog pa 'bum snyed du ma dag 'grub cing bde ba myong ste/dbang po lnga rnams kyi yul lnga rnams la myong bar byed do/ /dbang po kun rang gi yul gyis tshim pa med par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ mig gis gzugs gang mthong ba de dag zlos pa med par mthong la/ gang mthong ba de dag sna tshogs pa/nyams dga' ba mig tu 'ong ba yin no/ /mig dang bas 'dod pa/ sdug pa/yid du 'ong ba 'dzin cing mthong ste/ de ltar mig gzugs rnams kyis tshim pa 69wa 339

med do/ /gang rna bas mnyan pa yang nyams dga' ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin te / rna ba yang sgra rnams kyis tshim pa med do/ /de ltar snas kyang dri snom par byed de/ gang snom 3)pa de dag kyang 'dod pa/ sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba rnams la snom chosaste sna yang dri rnams kyis tshim pa med do/ /de ltar lces kyang ro rnams myong zhu)bar byed de/ gang myangasnyibar bya ba de dag kyang shin tu 'dod pa dag la myong parabar byed cing yid du 'ong ba dag la myong57bar byed do/ /de ltar lus kyis kyang reg bya la reg par byed de gang reg par bya ba de dag kyang 'dod pa / sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba dag la myong bar byed dome/ /de ltar yid kyis gang bsam par bya ba de yang 'dod pa/ sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba dag la sems par byed de/ de ltar sred pa'i tshogs drug la lus rnam par chags pa dag tshal de na dgod7par byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' dgur spyod par byed / rtse bar byed kyang 'dod pa rnams kyis tshim pa med do/ /de yul 'og ma dgon pa lta bu la dbang po mthon por byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa rlung lta bus bskyod 9)pa'i dge ba med pa shin tu byung ba'i mes nyin gcig bzhin sreg kyang /de sred pa'i 'dod pa rnams kyis tshim pa skyed par mi byed do/ /de ltar de dag dga' ba'i tshal na rtse zhing yul du ma la dga' ba myong ba kun du rtse ste/ dga' ba myong ba na lha ma yin las rnam par rgyal ba/ lha'i rgyal po brgya byin yang snga ma bzhin du ri brtsegs pa sna tshogs ga la ba der 'gro bar byed do/ /der song nas kyang lha rnams bos te lha dag /gle/dga' ba'i tshal du dga' bar gyis shig /lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa rnams kyis rtses shig /'di ltar bdag ni bdud kyi sde thags thertebazangs ris la 8sogs pa las rnam par rgyal 63—340

te/ bdag dga' ba'i tshal du 'gro yis517/ de ltar lha thams cad lha mo'i tshogs dang bdag cag rnams kyi dbyar zla ba bzhir gnas pa'i skyed mos tshal du dga' spyod bya ba ga la ba der dong la/ lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis nges par dga' bar bya'o zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams la bsgo nas/ shin tu dga' ba chen po dang yang dag par ldan pa glang po che sa srung gi bu bos te/ 'di ltar glang po che'i mchog chos shig /nga5snyeskyed mos tshal du dga' spyod bya ba'i phyir dga' ba'i tshal na skyed mos tshal gyi dga' spyod ga la ba der 'gro ste/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas yongs su bskor la dga' ba'i tshal ga la ba der 'dong gis 557khyod kyis ji ltar sngon yang yongs su sprul pa byas pa de/ de ltar khyod kyi rgyab tu zhon la pa dang / mgo la zhon pa dang / so la zhon pa dang / rtsib logs la zhon pa dang / gdeg pa pa dang ske/ tshal dang / mtsho dang / ri dang 67/ ri ri rtse dang / tshal dang /nye ba'i tshal dag sprul pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas brgya 87byin gyi tshig thos nas/ glang po che'i mchog sa srung gi bu bdag nyid 597chen por sprul te lus chen por byas so/ /de mgo brgyar misprul te mgo re re la so bcu bcu'o/ /so re re la pad ma'i rdzing bcu bcu'o/ /pad ma'i rdzing re re la pad ma stong stong ngo / /pad ma stong stong la ni rin po che sna bdun gyi 'dab ma yod do/ /'dab ma stong stong la rin po che sna bdun gyi bung ba yod cing / 'dab ma stong stong la lha rnams 'khod kyang lha mo'i tshogs dang phan tshun nyam nga ba med /1do/ /de dag glang po che mchog gi mgo la zhon pa/ lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa rnams dga' ba'i tshal ga la ba der nam mkha' las 'dong ngo / /69wa 341
